a: Mishna veellu yerakot sheadam yotze bahen yede chovato bappesach: bachazeret, betamcha, uvecharchavina uveuleshin uvemaror. yotzin bahen ben lachin ben yeveshin, aval lo kevushin velo shelukin velo mevushshalin.
Umitztarfin lichzayit, veyotzin bakkelach shellahen. uvidmay, uvemaaser rishon shennittela terumato, umaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu.
Gemara chazeret — chassa. uleshin — hindevi. tamcha, amar rabba bar bar chana: temachta shemah. charchavina, amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: atzvota dedikla. uvemaror — merirata.
Tane bar kappara, ellu yerakot sheadam yotze bahen yede chovato bappesach: beuleshin, uvetamcha, becharchalin, becharchavinin, uvechizrin. rav yehuda omer: af uleshe sade veuleshe ginna vachazeret.

Uleshe ginna vachazeret? ha tena la resha! hachi kaamar: af uleshe sade keuleshe ginna vachazeret. rabbi meir omer: af asvos vetura umar yeroar. amar leh rabbi yose: asvos vetura echad hu. umar — ze hu yeroar.

Tane deve (rabbi) shemuel: ellu yerakot sheadam yotze bahen yede chovato bappesach: bachazeret, beuleshin, uvetamcha, uvecharbinin, uvecharginin, uvehirdufenin. rabbi yehuda omer: af chazeret yulin vachazeret gallin kayyotze bahen.
Rabbi ila omer mishshum rabbi eliezer: af arkabbalim, vechazarti al kol talmidav uvikkashti li chaver, velo matzati. ucheshebbati lifne rabbi eliezer ben yaakov, hoda lidvaray.

Rabbi yehuda omer: kol sheyyesh lo saraf. rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: kol sheppanav machsifin. acherim omrim: [kol] yarak mar yesh lo saraf ufanav machsifin. amar rabbi yochanan: middivre kullan nilmad, yarak mar yesh lo saraf ufanav machsifin. amar rav huna: halacha kaacherim.

Ravina ashkecheh lerav acha bereh derava dahava mehaddar ammerirata. amar leh: may dataych, dimririn tefe? veha chazeret tenan. vetanna deve shemuel: chazeret, veamar rabbi oshaya: mitzva bachazeret. veamar rava: may chazeret — chassa.

May chassa — dechas rachamana illavavn. veamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: lamma nimshelu mitzriyyim kemaror? lomar lach: ma maror ze shettechillato rach vesofo kashe — af mitzriyyim techillatan rakka vesofan kasha. amar leh: hadari bi.

Amar leh rav rechumi leabbaye: mimmay dehay maror min yarak hu? ema merirata dechufeya? dumeya dematztza: ma matztza giddule karka — af maror giddule karka. veema hirduf? dumeya dematztza: ma matztza min zeraim — af maror min zeraim.
Veema harezifu! dumeya dematztza: ma matztza shennikkachat bechesef maaser — af maror shennikkach bechesef maaser.
Amar leh rabba bar rav chanin leabbaye: ema maror chad! "merorim" ketiv. veema "merorim" tere! dumeya dematztza: ma matztza minin harebe — af maror minin harebe.
Amar rabba bar rav huna amar rav: yerakot sheamru chachamim sheadam yotze bahen yede chovato bappesach, kullan nizrain baaruga achat. lememra delet behu mishshum kilayim?

Metiv rava: chazeret vachazeret gallin, uleshin veuleshe sade, kereshin uchereshe sade, kusebar vechusebar sade, chardal vechardal mitzri, vedallaat hammitzri veharmutza — enam kilayim ze baze. chazeret vachazeret gallin — in, chazeret veuleshin — lo!
Vechi tema kullehu bahadade katane lehu. veha amar rav: zugot zugot katane!
May nizrain deamar rav — nizrain kehilchatan. kehilchatan? tenena:
b: Aruga shehi shishsha al shishsha tefachim — zorin betochah chamishsha zeronin, arba — al arba ruchot haaruga, veachat baemtza. mahu detema: hane mille bizrain, aval birakot — la, ka mashma lan.
Lememra dirakot allima mizzeraim? vehatnan: kol mine zeraim en zorin baaruga achat, kol mine yerakot zorin baaruga achat! mahu detema hane maror min zeraim ninhu, ka mashma lan.
Zeraim salka datach? veha tenan — yerakot, vetane bar kappara — yerakot, vetane deve shemuel — yerakot! chazeret itztericha leh. salka datach amena: hoil vesofah lehakeshot — nittev la ravvcha tefe.
Lav amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina, kelach shel keruv shehukesha marchivin lo bet rova! alma: kevan desofo lehakeshot yahavinan leh ravvcha tefe, hacha name nittev la ravvcha tefe, ka mashma lan.
Yotzin bahen ben lachin ben yeveshin kulei. amar rav chisda: lo shanu ella bakkelach, aval bealin, lachin — in, yeveshin — la.
Veha middekatane sefa "bakkelach shellahen", michlal deresha alin? paroshe ka mefaresh: ki katane ben lachin ben yeveshin — akkelach.

Metivi: yotzin bahen uvakkelach shellahen, ben lachin ben yeveshin, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: lachin — yotzin bahen, yeveshin — en yotzin bahen. veshavin sheyyotzin bahen kemushin. aval lo kevushin velo shelukin velo mevushshalin.

Kelalo shel davar: kol sheyyesh bo taam maror — yotzin bo, vechol sheen bo taam maror — en yotzin bo. targuma akkelach. tanu rabbanan: en yotzin bahen kemushin. mishshum rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok amru: yotzin bahen kemushin.
Bae rame bar chama: mahu sheyyetze adam yede chovato bemaror shel maaser sheni birushalayim? allibba derabbi akiva la tibbee lach: hasheta bematztza deorayyta nafek, bemaror derabbanan mibbaya?
Ki tibbee lach allibba derabbi yose haggelili, may? bematztza deorayyta hu dela nafek, aval maror derabbanan nafek?
O dilma: kol detakkinu rabbanan — keen deorayyta takkun. amar rava: mistabbera matztza umaror.

Mishna en shorin et hammuresan letarnegolim, aval choltin. haishsha lo tishre et hammuresan shettolich beyadah lammerchatz, aval shafa hi bivsarah yavesh. lo yilos adam chittin veyanniach al makkato, mippene shehen machmitzot.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: ellu devarim sheen bain lide chimmutz: haafuy, vehamevushshal, vechalut shechalato berotchin. mevushshal? addimvashshel leh, machma! amar rav pappa: haafuy shebbishshelo kaamar.
Tanya, rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: kemach shennafal letocho delef, afillu kol hayyom kullo — eno ba lide chimmutz, amar rav pappa: vehu deaved tif lahade tif.
Amri deve rabbi shela: vatika shere. vehatanya vatika asur?! la kashya: ha — deavdeh bemishcha umilcha, ha — deavdeh bemayya umilcha.
Amar mar zutera: la limache inish kidra bekimcha daavishuna, dilma la beshil shappir, veate lide chimmutz. amar rav yosef: la lichlot inish

a: Tere chitte bahade hadade, dilma azla chada veyatva betzirya dachaverta, vela salek lehu dikkula demayya mearba ruchata, veate lide chimmutz.

Veamar abbaye: la lichroch inish tere shuvle bahade hadade, dilma nafki mayya mehay uvala iddach, veatya lide chimmutz. amar leh rava: i hachi, afillu chada name, dilma nafek mehay resha uvala iddach resha! ella amar rava: me ferot ninhu, ume ferot enan machmitzin.

Vahadar beh abbaye mehahi, dechol aggav medalayyhu la machmetzi. deamar abbaye: hay chatzba daavishuna, sechifa — shere, zekifa — asur. rava amar: afillu zekifa — name shere, me ferot ninhu, ume ferot enan machmitzin.
Tanu rabbanan: en lottin seorin bappesach. veim latat, nitbakkeu — asurot, lo nitbakkeu — muttarot.
Rabbi yose omer: shoran bechometz, vechometz tzomtan. amar shemuel: en halacha kerabbi yose.

Amar rav chisda amar mar ukeva: lo nitbakkeu mammash, ella kol sheillu mannichan al pi chavit vehen nitbakkeot meelehen, ushemuel amar: nitbakkeu mammash. avad shemuel ovada bedura deve bar chashu nitbakkeu mammash.
Amar rabba: baal nefesh lo yiltot. may irya baal nefesh? afillu kulle alma name, deha tanya: en lottin seorin bappesach! hachi kaamar: baal nefesh — afillu chittin dishriri lo yiltot.
Amar leh rav nachman: man detzayet leh leabba — achel nahama deippusha. deha be rav huna latti, uve rava bar avin latti. verava amar: asur liltot.

Ella ha detanya: en lottin seorin bappesach. seorin hu dela, ha chitte — shere. la mibbaya kaamar. la mibbaya chittin, kevan deit beh tzirya — ayyli behu mayya, aval seare deshii — ema shappir dame, ka mashma lan.
Hadar amar rava: muttar liltot. detanya: yotzin befat nekiyya vehaderaa, vei efshar nekiyya belo letita.
Etiveh rav pappa lerava: hakkemachin vehasselatot shel goyim, shel kefarim — tehorim, veshel kerakkin — temein.
Dichfarim may tama? lav mishshum dela latti, veka kare leh solet!
Targuma akkimcha. batar denafek amar: may tama la ema leh meha deamar rabbi zera amar rav yirmeya amar shemuel: chittin shel menachot en lottin otam, veka kare lehu solet.
Hadar amar rava: mitzva liltot, shenneemar "ushemartem et hammatztzot" — i la devae letita shimmur lemay? i shimmur delisha — shimmur delisha lav shimmur hu.
Deamar rav huna: betzekot shel goyim — adam memalle kereso mehen, uvilvad sheyyochal kezayit matztza baacharona. baacharona — in, barishona — la,
May tama? mishshum dela avad behu shimmur. velabed leh shimmur meafiyya veelach! ella lav shema minna, shimmur meikkara baenan.
Vmimmay? dilma shane hatam, dividdana denachet leshimmur — la aved la shimmur. aval hecha dividdana denachet leshimmur — aved la shimmur, hachi name deshimmur delisha have shimmur.
Vaafillu hachi la hadar beh rava. deamar lehu lehanhu dimhappechi kefe: ki mehappechitu — happichu leshum mitzva, alma kasavar: shimmur meikkara mittechillato vead sofo baenan.
Mar bereh deravina
b: Menakketa leh immeh bearve.
Hahu arba dechitte ditvaa bechishta, sharya rava lezabbone legoyim.
Etiveh rabba bar levay lerava: beged sheavad bo kilayim — hare ze lo yimkerennu legoy, velo yaase bo mardaat lachamor. aval osin oto tachrichin lemet.
Legoy may tama la — lav mishshum dahadar mezabben leyisrael?
Hadar amar rava: lezabbinhu kabba kabba leyisrael, ki hechi dechalya kamme pischa.
Tanu rabbanan: en mollin et hakkedera bappesach. veharotze sheyyimlol — noten et hakkemach veachar kach noten et hachometz. veyesh omrim: af noten et hachometz veachar kach noten et hakkemach.
Man yesh omrim?

Amar rav chisda: rabbi yehuda hi, ditnan: hailpas vehakkedera sheheeviran meruttachin — lo yitten letochan tavlin, aval noten letoch hakkeara o letoch hattamchuy. rabbi yehuda omer: lakkol hu noten, chutz middavar sheyyesh bo chometz vatzir.
Venokma kerabbi yose, (ditnan) rabbi yose omer: shoran bechometz, vechometz tzomtan!
Ki ashmeinan leh lerabbi yose, hane mille deiteh beeneh, aval al yede taarovet — la.
Ulla amar: echad ze veechad ze — asur, mishshum: "lech lech amrinan nezira, sechor sechor, lecharma la tikrav".
Rav pappi share leh levurediki deve resh galuta lemimche kedera bachasise. amar rava: ikka deshare ki hay milleta beducheta dishchichi avdi? ikka deamri: rava gufa mache le kidra bachasise.
Mishna en notnin kemach letoch charoset o letoch hachardal. veim natan — yeachel miyyad, verabbi meir oser.
En mevashshelin et happesach lo bemashkin velo beme ferot, aval sachin umatbilin oto bahen.
Me tashmisho shel nachtom — yishshafchu, mippene shehen machmitzin.
Gemara amar rav kahana: machaloket letoch hachardal, aval letoch charoset — divre hakkol yissaref miyyad.

Vetanya name hachi: en notnin kemach letoch hacharoset, veim natan — yissaref miyyad. letoch hachardal, rabbi meir omer: yissaref miyyad, vachachamim omrim: yeachel miyyad. amar rav huna bereh derav yehuda amar rav nachman amar shemuel: halacha kedivre chachamim. amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerav huna bereh derav yehuda:

a: Acharoset kaamar mar, o achardal kaamar mar? amar leh: lemay nafka minna?
Lidrav kahana. deamar rav kahana: machaloket letoch hachardal, aval letoch hacharoset — divre hakkol yissaref miyyad.
Amar leh: la shemia li, kelomar la sevira li.
Amar rav ashe: kevoteh derav kahana mistabbera, middeamar shemuel: en halacha kerabbi yose. may lav? tzammote hu dela tzamet, ha chammoe mechammea.
La, dilma la mitzmat tzamet, vela chammoe mechamma.
En mevashshelin vechulei. tanu rabbanan: "bemayim" — en li ella bemayim, shear mashkin minnayin?
Amarta, kal vachomer: uma mayim sheen mefigin taman — asurin, shear mashkin shemmefigin taman — lo kol shekken!
Rabbi omer: "bemayim" — en li ella mayim, shear mashkin minnayin? talmud lomar: "uvashel mevushshal", mikkol makom.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu tzeli kedar.
Verabbanan, hay "bashel mevushshal" may avdi lehu? mibbee leh lechidtanya: bishshelo veachar kach tzelao, o shetztzelao veachar kach bishshelo — chayyayv.
Bishlama bishshelo veachar kach tzelao chayyayv, deha bashsheleh. ella tzelao veachar kach bishshelo, ha tzeli esh hu, ammay?

Amar rav kahana: ha manni — rabbi yose hi. detanya: yotzin berakik hashsharuy uvimvushshal shello nimmoach, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer: yotzin berakik hashsharuy, aval lo bimvushshal, af al pi shello nimmoach.
Ulla amar: afillu tema rabbi meir, shane hacha deamar kera: "uvashel mevushshal", mikkol makom.
Tanu rabbanan: yachol tzelao kol tzorko yehe chayyayv — talmud lomar: "al tochlu mimmennu na uvashel mevushshal bammayim". na uvashel mevushshal amarti lecha, velo shetztzelao kol tzorko.
Hechi dame? amar rav ashe: deshavveye charocha.
Tanu rabbanan: yachol achal kezayit chay yehe chayyayv — talmud lomar: "al tochlu mimmennu na uvashel mevushshal". na uvashel amarti lecha, velo chay.
Yachol yehe muttar — talmud lomar: "ki im tzeli esh". hechi dame na? amar rav: kidamri parsae: avarnim.
Amar rav chisda: hamevashshel bechamme teverya beshabbat — patur. pesach shebbishshelo bechamme teverya — chayyayv.
May shena beshabbat dela? detoldot esh baenan, velekka. pesach name, lav toldot esh hu!
Amar rava: may "chayyayv" dekatane — deka avar mishshum "tzali esh".

Rav chiyyay bereh derav natan matne la leha derav chisda behedya. amar rav chisda: hamevashshel bechamme teverya beshabbat — patur, ufesach shebbishshelo bechamme teverya — chayyayv, sheavar mishshum "tzeli esh".
Amar rava: achalo na —
b: Loke shetayim. mevushshal — loke shetayim. na umevushshal — loke shalosh.
Abbaye amar: en lokin al lav shebbichlalot.
Ikka deamri: tarte hu dela lake, chada mihat lake.
Ikka deamri: chada name la lake, dela meyaychad laveh kelav dachasima.
Rava amar: achal zag — loke shetayim. chartzan — loke shetayim. zag vechartzan — loke shalosh.
Abbaye amar: en lokin al lav shebbichlalot. ikka deamri: tarte hu dela lake, chada mihat lake. ikka deamri: chada name la lake, dela meyaychad laveh kelav dachasima.

Tanu rabbanan: achal kezayit na mibbeod yom — patur; kezayit na mishshechashecha — chayyayv. achal kezayit tzali mibbeod yom — lo pasal atzmo mibbene chavura; kezayit tzali mishshechashecha — pasal atzmo mibbene hachavura.

Tanya iddach: yachol achal kezayit na mibbeod yom yehe chayyayv, vedin hu: uma beshaa sheyyeshno bekum echol tzali — yeshno beval tochal na. beshaa sheeno bekum echol tzali — eno din sheyyeshno beval tochal na?
O lo: beshaa sheeno bekum echol tzali — yeshno beval tochal na, beshaa sheyyeshno bekum echol tzali — eno beval tochal na.
Veal titma, shehare huttar mikkelalo etzel tzali.

Talmud lomar: "al tochlu mimmennu na uvashel mevushshal bammayim ki im tzeli esh", sheen talmud lomar "ki im tzeli esh", uma talmud lomar "ki im tzeli esh"? lomar lach: beshaa sheyyeshno bekum echol tzali — yeshno beval tochal na, beshaa sheeno bekum echol tzali — eno beval tochal na.
Rabbi omer: ekra ani "bashel", ma talmud lomar "mevushshal"? sheyyachol en li ella shebbishshelo mishshechashecha, bishshelo mibbeod yom minnayin — talmud lomar "bashel mevushshal" mikkol makom.
Vehay "bashel mevushshal" appekeh rabbi litzli kedar velishar mashkin!
Im ken — lema kera o "bashel bashel", o "mevushshal mevushshal". may "bashel mevushshal"? shamat minna tarte.
Tanu rabbanan: achal tzali mibbeod yom — chayyayv, uchezayit na mishshechashecha — chayyayv.
Katane tzali dumeya dena: ma na belav, af tzali belav.
Bishlama na, ketiv: "al tochlu mimmennu na", ella tzali menalan?
Dichtiv: "veachlu et habbasar ballayla hazze". ballayla — in, bayyom — la.
Hay lav habba mikkelal ase hu, vechol lav habba mikkelal ase — ase!
Amar rav chisda: ha manni

a: Rabbi yehuda hi, detanya: "shor vase sarua vekalut nedava taase oto". oto atta matpis levedek habbayit, vei atta matpis temimim levedek habbayit. mikkan amru: kol hammatpis temimim levedek habbayit over baase.
En li ella baase, belo taase minnayin? talmud lomar: "vaydabber Adonai el moshe lemor", limmed al kol happarasha kullah sheyyehe belo taase, divre rabbi yehuda.
Amar lo rabbi levar kappara: may mashma?
Amar lo: dichtiv "lemor" — lo neemar baddevarim.
Be rav amri: "lemor" — lav emor.
Me tashmisho shel nachtom vechulei. tane chada: shofchin bimkom midron, veen shofchin bimkom haeshboren. vetanya iddach: shofchin bimkom haeshboren!
La kashya: ha — dinfishi, dikvu. ha — dela nefishi, dela kevu.
Amar rav yehuda: ishsha lo talush ella bemayim shellanu.
Darsha rav matna befapponya. lemachar ayyto kulle alma chatzvayyhu vaato legabbeh, vaamaru leh: hav lan mayya. amar lehu: ana bemayya devitu amari.

Daresh rava: ishsha lo talush bachamma, velo bechamme chamma, velo bammayim haggerufin min hammuleyayr, velo tagbiah yadah min hattannur ad shettigmor et kol happat. vetzarich shene chelim — echad shemmekattefet bo, veechad shemmetzannenet bo et yadeha.
Ibbaya lehu: avra velasha, mahu? mar zutera amar: muttar, rav ashe amar: asur.
Amar mar zutera: mena amena la? detanya: en lottin hasseorin bappesach. veim latat, nitbakkeu — asurim, lo nitbakkeu — muttarin.
Verav ashe amar: attu kullehu chada mechita mechitinhu?! hecha deittemar — ittemar, vehecha dela ittemar — la ittemar.
Hadran alach kol shaa
Mishna veellu ovrin bappesach: kuttach habbavli, veshechar hammadi, vechometz haadomi, vezetom hammitzri, vezoman shel tzabbaim, vaamilan shel tabbachim, vekolan shel sofrim.
Rabbi eliezer omer: af tachshite nashim.
Ze hakkelal: kol shehu mimmin dagan — hare ze over bappesach. hare ellu baazhara, veen bahen mishshum karet.
Gemara tanu rabbanan, shelosha devarim neemarim bechuttach habbavli: metamtem et hallev, umesamme et haenayim, umachchish et hagguf.
Metamtem et hallev — mishshum nasyuve dachalava. umesamme et haenayim — mishshum milcha. umachchish et hagguf — mishshum komanita deuma.
Tanu rabbanan: shelosha devarim marbin hazzevel, vechoffin et hakkoma, venotlin echad mechamesh meot mimmeor enav shel adam, ellu hen: pat kibbar, veshechar chadash, veyarak chay.
Tanu rabbanan: shelosha devarim memaatin et hazzevel, vezokfin et hakkoma, umeirin et haenayim, ellu hen: pat nekiyyay, basar shamen, veyayin yashan. pat nekiyyay —
b: Dismida, basar shamen — ditzfirta dela ippetach, yayin yashan — attik attike.
Kol mille dimalle lehay — kashe lehay, udekashe lehay — mealle lehay, bar mizzangevila rattiva, ufilpele arichta, ufat nekiyyay, uvasar shamen, veyayin yashan — dimalle lechulle gufeh.
Shechar hammadi. deramu beh me seare.
Vechometz haadomi. deshadu beh seare.
Amar rav nachman (bar yitzchak): battechilla keshehayu meviin nesachim miyyehuda, lo haya yenam shel yehuda machmitz, ad shennotnin letochan seorin. vehayu korin oto chometz setam.

Veachshav en yenam shel adomiyyim machmitz ad shennotnin letochan seorin, vekorin oto chometz haadomi, lekayyem ma shenneemar: "immala hochorava", im melea zo — chareva zo, veim melea zo — chareva zo. rav nachman bar yitzchak amar, mehacha: "uleom milleom yeematz".

Tanya, amar rabbi yehuda: bihuda, barishona hallokeach chometz meam haaretz — eno tzarich leasser, mippene shechazaka eno ba ella min hattemed. veachshav, hallokeach chometz meam haaretz — tzarich leasser, shechezkato eno ba ella min hayyayin.
Vesavar rabbi yehuda: temed lav bar assore hu? veha (tenan): hametammed venatan mayim bammidda, umatza kede middato — patur, verabbi yehuda mechayyev?
Hachi kaamar: lo nechshedu amme haaretz al hattemed. i baet ema: nechshedu, vela kashya: ha — bedirvoka, ha — bidfuretzane.
Vezetom hammitzri vechulei. may zetom hammitzri?
Tana rav yosef: telata seare, telata kuretme, utelata milcha.
Rav pappa mappek seare umeayyel chitte, vesimanaych sisane.
Taru lehu vekalu lehu vetachani lehu veshatu lehu middivcha vead atzarta. dikmit merappe leh, vedirfe mekammet leh, lechole uleishsha ubbara sakkanta.
Vezoman shel tzabbaim vechulei. hacha targimu: mayya dechivvare detzavi behu libba.
Vaamilan shel tabbachim vechulei. pat tevua shello hevia shelish, shemmannichah al pi kedera veshoevet hazzuhama.
Vekolan shel sofrim vechulei. hacha targuma: perura deushekafe.
Rav shimi machoznaa amar: ze tippulan shel benot ashirim, shemmeshayyeyrot oto livnot aniyyim.
Ini? veha tane rabbi chiyyay: arbaa mine medina, ushelosha mine ummanut. vei amrat tippulan shel benot ashirim, may mine ummanut ikka?

Veella may, perura deushekafe? ammay kare leh hay kolan shel sofrim? kolan shel ratzanin mibbaya leh! amar rav oshaya: leolam perura deushekafe, umay kare leh kolan shel sofrim? desofrim name medabbekin behu neyayrotehen.
Rabbi eliezer omer af tachshite nashim vechulei. tachshite nashim salka datach? ella ema: af tippule nashim. deamar rav yehuda amar rav: benot yisrael

a: Shehiggiu lefirkan, velo higgiu leshanim, benot aniyyim — toflot otan besid, benot ashirim — toflot otan besolet, benot melachim — beshemen hammor, shenneemar: "shishsha chodashim beshemen hammor".
May "shemen hammor"? rav huna bar yirmeya omer: setachat. rav yirmeya bar abba amar: shemen zayit shello hevi shelish.
Tanya rabbi yehuda omer: anpiknin — shemen zayit shello hevi shelish, velamma sachin oto? mippene shemmashshir et hassear umeadden et habbasar.

Ze hakkelal kol shehu mimmin dagan. tanya, amar rabbi yehoshua: vechi meachar sheshshaninu kol shehu min dagan hare ze over befesach, lamma manu chachamim et ellu? kede sheyyehe ragil bahen uvishmotehen.
Ki ha dehahu bar mareva ikkela levavel, hava bisra bahadeh, amar lehu: karivu li matkilta. shema dekaamri: karivu leh kuttach. kevan dishma kuttach — perash.
Hare ellu beazhara.
Man tanna dechametz dagan gamur al yede taarovot, venukeshe beeneh belav?
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: rabbi meir hi, detanya: siur — yissaref, venotno lechalbo, vehaochlo — bearbaim.
Ha gufa kashya, amrat "siur yissaref", alma asur bahanaa, vahadar tane: venotno lifne kalbo, alma muttar bahanaa!
Hachi kaamar: siur yissaref — derabbi meir lerabbi meir, derabbi yehuda lerabbi yehuda. venotno lifne kalbo — derabbi meir lerabbi yehuda.
Vehaochlo bearbaim — atan lerabbi meir.
Shaminan leh lerabbi meir nukeshe beeneh — belav. vechol shekken chametz dagan gamur al yede taarovet.

Rav nachman amar: rabbi eliezer hi, detanya: al chametz dagan gamur — anush karet, al eruvo — belav, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim: al chametz dagan gamur — anush karet, al eruvo — belo kelum. veshaminan leh lerabbi eliezer deamar chametz dagan gamur al yede taarovet — belav, vechol shekken nukeshe beeneh.
Verav nachman, may tama la amar kerav yehuda?
Amar lach: dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi meir hatam ella nukeshe beeneh, aval chametz dagan gamur al yede taarovet — la.
Verav yehuda may tama la amar kerav nachman?
Amar lach: ad kan la kaamar rabbi eliezer hatam ella chametz dagan gamur al yede taarovet. aval nukeshe beeneh — la amar.

Tanya kevoteh derav yehuda: "kol machmetzet lo tochelu" — lerabbot kuttach habbavli veshechar hammadi vechometz haadomi vezetom hammitzri. yachol yehe anush karet? talmud lomar: "ki kol ochel chametz venichreta", al chametz dagan gamur — anush karet, veal eruvo — belav.
Man shamat leh deamar al eruvo belav? rabbi eliezer hi, veillu nukeshe beeneh la kaamar. shema minna: nukeshe lerabbi eliezer let leh.
Verabbi eliezer, eruvo belav mena leh? dichtiv: "kol machmetzet lo tochelu".
I hachi, karet name lechayyev, deha ketiv: "ki kol ochel machmetzet venichreta"!
Hahu mibbee leh lechidtanya, ("machmetzet") en li ella shennitchammetz meelav, mechamat davar acher minnayin? talmud lomar: "kol ... machmetzet venichreta".
I hachi, delav name lehachi hu daata!
Ella: tama derabbi eliezer mikkol".
Hatam name, hachtiv "kol"? hahu mibbee leh — lerabbot et hannashim.

Nashim midderav yehuda amar rav nafka, deamar rav yehuda amar rav, vechen tana deve rabbi yishmael: amar kera "ish o ishsha ki yaasu mikkol chattot haadam", hishva hakkatuv ish leishsha lechol onashin shebbattora.
Itzterich,
b: Salka datach amena: hoil uchetiv "lo tochal alav chametz shivat yamim tochal alav matztzot", kol sheyyeshno bekum echol matztza — yeshno beval tochal chametz, vehane neshe, hoil veletanhu bekum echol matztza, dehavya lay mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama (hi) — ema beval tochal chametz name letanhu, ka mashma lan.

Vehasheta deitrabbu lehu beval tochal chametz — itrabbi name laachilat matztza, kerabbi (eliezer). deamar rabbi eliezer: nashim chayyayvot baachilat matztza devar tora, shenneemar: "lo tochal alav chametz vegomer", kol sheyyeshno beval tochal chametz — yeshno baachilat matztza. vehane neshe name, hoil veyoshnan beval tochal chametz — yeshnan bekum echol matztza.
Umay chazet dehay "kol" lerabboye nashim, umappekat eruvo? ema: lerabboye eruvo!
Mistabbera, kae beochlin merabbe ochlin. kae beochlin merabbe neechalin?

Matkef la rav natan avu derav huna (bereh derav natan): vechol hecha dekae beochlin la merabbe neechalin? veha tanya: "ki kol ochel chelev min habbehema asher yakriv", en li ella chelev temimin sherauy likrav, chelev baale mumin minnayin? talmud lomar: "min habbehema". chelev chullin minnayin? talmud lomar: "ki kol". veha hacha dekae beochlin, veka merabbe neechalin!
Hatam delekka ochlin — merabbe neechalin. hacha deikka ochlin — la shavek lehu leochlin umerabbe neechalin.
Verabbanan delet lehu eruv, "kol" la darshi. ella nashim mena lehu?
"Kol" — la darshi, "ki kol" — darshi.
Verabbi eliezer, ema: "kol" — lerabbot et hannashim, "ki kol" — lerabbot et eruvo!

Vechi tema "ki kol" rabbi eliezer la daresh, vehatanya: seor bal taktiru — en li ella kullo, miktzato minnayin? talmud lomar: "kol". eruvo minnayin? talmud lomar: "ki kol". man shamat leh dedaresh "kol" — rabbi eliezer, veka daresh "ki kol"!
Kashya.
Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: kol issurin shebbattora — en hetter mitztaref leissur, chutz meissure nazir, shehare amra tora "mishrat".
Uzeeri amar: af seor bal taktiru.
Keman? kerabbi eliezer, dedaresh "kol".
I hachi

a: Leinyan chametz bappesach name.
In hachi name. uleappoke middeabbayye deamar: yesh haketara lefachot mikkezayit, kamashma lan dehaktara lav lefachot mikkezayit.
Yatev rav dimi vekaamar la leha shemata. amar leh abbaye lerav dimi: vechol issurin shebbattora en hetter mitztaref leissur?

Vehatnan: hammikpa shel teruma vehashshum vehashshemen shel chullin, venaga tevul yom bemiktzatan — pasal et kullan. hammikpa shel chullin vehashshum vehashshemen shel teruma, venaga tevul yom bemiktzatan — lo pasal ella mekom maggao bilvad.
Vehavenan ba: mekom maggao ammay pesula? ha batli lehu tavlin berov! veamar rabba bar bar chana: ma taam — hoil vezar loke alehen bichzayit. hechi dame, lav mishshum dehetter mitztaref leissur?
La, may kezayit — deikka kezayit bichde achilat peras.
Uchezayit bichde achilat peras deorayyta hi? amar leh: in.
I hachi, ammay peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi eliezer bechuttach habbavli?

Ella may, mishshum dehetter mitztaref leissur? sof sof ammay peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi eliezer bechuttach habbavli? ella: hannach lechuttach habbavli delet beh kezayit bichde achilat peras. i beeneh dekasaref vekaachel leh, batla dateh etzel kol adam. vei mishtar kashatar veachel — let beh kezayit bichde achilat peras.

Etiveh: shete kederot, achat shel chullin veachat shel teruma, velifnehen shete medochot, achat shel chullin veachat shel teruma, venaflu ellu letoch ellu — muttarin. sheani omer: teruma letoch hatteruma nafla, vechullin letoch chullin naflu,
Vei amrat kezayit bichde achilat peras deorayyta, ammay amrinan "sheani omer teruma letoch kulei"? amar leh: hannach litrumat tavlin derabbanan.

Etiveh: shete kuppot, achat shel chullin veachat shel teruma, velifnehem shene sein, achat shel chullin veachat shel teruma, venaflu ellu letoch ellu — muttarin, sheani omer: chullin letoch chullin naflu, teruma letoch teruma nafla. vei amrat kezayit bichde achilat peras deorayyta — ammay amrinan "sheani omer"?
Amar leh: hannach litruma bazzeman hazze derabbanan.
Vehay "mishrat" lehachi hu daata? hay mibbee leh lechidtanya: "mishrat" —
b: Litten taam keikkar. sheim shara anavim bemayim, veyesh bahen taam yayin — chayyayv.

Mikkan atta dan lechol hattora kullah: uma nazir sheen issuro issur olam, veen issuro issur hanaa, veyesh hetter leissuro — asa bo taam keikkar, kilayim, sheissuro issur olam, veissuro issur hanaa, veen hetter leissuro — eno din sheyyaase taam keikkar?
Vehu haddin leorla bishtayim!
Ha manni rabbanan hi, verabbi yochanan deamar kerabbi akiva.

He rabbi akiva? ilema rabbi akiva dematnitin, ditnan: rabbi akiva omer: nazir sheshshara pitto beyayin, veyesh bo letzaref kede kezayit — chayyayv, umimmay demippat umiyyayin? dilma miyyayin lechodeh?
Vechi tema: miyyayin lechodeh may lememra? ha ka mashma lan deaf al gav detaarovet.
Ella rabbi akiva devarayyta. detanya, rabbi akiva omer: nazir sheshshara pitto beyayin, veachal kezayit mippat umiyyayin — chayyayv.
Verabbi akiva taam keikkar mena leh? yalef mibbasar bechalav: lav tama bealma hu, veasur? hacha name la shena.
Verabbanan? mibbasar bechalav la gamrinan, dechiddush hu.
Umay chiddush? illema dehay lechodeh vehay lechodeh — shere, uvahade hadade — asur, kilayim name: hay lechodeh vehay lechodeh — shere, uvahadadi — asur.
Ella: dei taru leh kulle yoma bachalava — shere, bashshel leh bashshole — asur.
Verabbi akiva name, basar bechalav vadday chiddush hu?
Ella yalef miggiule goyim: giule goyim, lav tama bealma hu, veasur? hacha name la shena.
Verabbanan, giule goyim name chiddush hu. deha kol noten taam lifgam — muttar, degamrinan minnevela — vehacha asur.
Verabbi akiva kidrav chiyyay bereh derav huna, deamar: lo asra tora ella bikdera bat yoma, hilkach lav noten taam lifgam hu.
Verabbanan? kedera bat yoma name, la efshar dela pagma pureta.

Amar leh rav acha bereh derav avya lerav ashe: midderabbanan nishma lerabbi akiva, mi la amri rabbanan "mishrat" litten taam keikkar, mikkan atta dan lechol issurin shebbattora. lerabbi akiva name — "mishrat" lehetter mitztaref leissur, mikkan atta dan lechol issurin shebbattora kullah!
Amar leh:

a: Mishshum dehave nazir vechattat shene chetuvin habbain keechad, veen melammedin.
Nazir, ha daamaran. chattat may hi? detanya: "kol asher yigga bivsarah yikdash vegomer", yachol afillu lo bala? talmud lomar: "bivsarah (yikdash)" — ad sheyyibbala bevasar
"Yikdash" — lihyot kamoha, sheim pesula hi — tippasel, veim keshera hi — teachel kechamur shebbah.
Verabbanan name, nihve nazir vechattat shene chetuvin habbain keechad, veen melammedin!
Amri: hanhu mitzraych tzerichi.

Verabbi akiva, may tzerichi? bishlama i ketav rachamana bechattat, la gamar nazir minna — dechullin mikkodashim la gamrinan. ella, lichtov rachamana benazir, vetete chattat vetigmor minneh, deha kol issurin shebbattora ka gamar minnazir.
Verabbanan amri lach, mitzrach tzerichi: chattat lehetter mitztaref leissur, vechullin mikkodashim la gamar, umishrat" — litten taam keikkar, umikkan atta dan lechol hattora kullah.
Verabbi akiva: tarvayyhu lehetter mitztaref leissur, vehavu lehu shene chetuvin habbain keechad, vechol shene chetuvin habbain keechad en melammedin.

Amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana, ella ha detanya: "mikkol asher yease miggefen hayyayin mechartzannim vead zag" — limmed al issure nazir shemmitztarfim ze im ze. hasheta: lerabbi akiva issur vehetter mitztarfin, issur veissur mibbaya?!
Amar leh: issur vehetter bevat achat, issur veissur baze achar ze.
Mishna batzek shebbesidke areva, im yesh kezayit bemakom echad — chayyayv levaer, veim (lo) — batel bemiuto.
Vechen leinyan hattumea, im makpid alav — chotzetz, veim rotze bekiyyumo — hare hu kaareva.
Gemara amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: lo shanu ella bimkom sheen asuyin lechazzek, aval bimkom sheasuyin lechazzek — eno chayyayv levaer.
Michlal defachot mikkezayit — afillu bimkom sheen asuy lechazzek eno chayyayv levaer.

Ikka dematne la assefa: "veim lav batel bemiuto". amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: lo shanu ella bimkom heasuy lechazzek, aval bimkom sheen asuy lechazzek — chayyayv levaer, mikkelal dichzayit — afillu bimkom heasuy lechazzek chayyayv levaer.

Tanya kelishshana kamma, tanya kelishshana batra. tanya kelishshana kamma: batzek shebbesidke areva, bimkom heasuy lechazzek — eno chotzetz veeno over. uvimkom sheen asuy lechazzek — chotzetz veover. bamme devarim amurim? bichzayit, aval befachot mikkezayit — afillu bimkom sheen asuy lechazzek, eno chotzetz veeno over.
Vetanya kelishshana batra: batzek shebbesidke areva, bimkom heasuy lechazzek —
b: Eno chotzetz veeno over. bimkom sheen asuy lechazzek — chotzetz veover. bamme devarim amurim — befachot mikkezayit, aval bichzayit — afillu bimkom heasuy lechazzek chotzetz veover.
Kashyayn ahadade. amar rav huna: semi killeta mikkamme chamirta.
Rav yosef amar: tannae shaklat mealma?! tannae hi. detanya: happat sheippesha — chayyayv levaer, mippene sherauy leshochkah ulechammea bah kamma issot acherot.

Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: bamme devarim amurim — bimkuyyemet laachila, aval kofet seor sheyyichadah lishiva — batla. middeamar rabbi shimon ben elazar batla, mikkelal detanna kamma savar lo batla, alma kasavar: kol kezayit, af al gav dimvattel — la betil.
Amar leh abbaye: taretzt bichzayit. pachot mikkezayit mi taretzt? ella ha veha rabbi shimon ben elazar hi, vela kashya: ha — bimkom lisha, ha — shello bimkom lisha.
Amar rav ashe: la tema shello bimkom lisha — aggabba deaggana, ella assifta deaggana.
Peshita? mahu detema zimna deatef umate lehatam, ka mashma lan.
Amar rav nachman amar rav: halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar.
Ini? vehaamar rav yitzchak bar ashe amar rav: im tach paneha betit — batla. tach in, lo tach — la!
Man dematne ha la matne ha.
Ikka deamri, amar rav nachman amar rav: en halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar, deamar rav yitzchak bar ashe amar rav: im tach paneha betit — batla vechulei.
Amar rav nachman amar shemuel: shene chatzae zetim vechut shel batzek benehen, roin: kol sheillu yinnatel hachut venittalin immo — chayyayv levaer. veim lav — eno chayyayv levaer.
Amar ulla: la amaran ella baareva, aval babbayit — chayyayv levaer.
May tama, dezimnin dechanesh lehu venafli gabbe hadade.
Amar ulla: bau bemareva, bayit vaaliyyay mahu? bayit veachsadra mahu? shene vattim ze lifnim mizze mahu?
Teku.

Tanu rabbanan: happat sheippesha venifsela milleechol laadam, vehakkelev yachol leochlah — metammea tumeat ochalin bichvetza, venisrefet im hattemea bappesach. mishshum rabbi natan amru: enah metammea.
Keman azla ha ditnan, kelal amru bitharot: kol hameyuchad leochel adam — tame ad sheyyippasel milleechol lechelev. keman — dela kerabbi natan.

Tanu rabbanan: arevat haabbedanin shennatan letochah kemach, toch shelosha yamim — chayyayv levaer. kodem shelosha yamim eno chayyayv levaer. amar rabbi natan: bamme devarim amurim — shello natan letochah orot, aval natan letochah orot — afillu toch shelosha en chayyayv levaer.
Amar rava: halacha kerabbi natan, afillu yom echad vaafillu shaa achat.
Vechen leinyan tumea, im makpid alav — chotzetz, veim rotze bekiyyumo — hare hu kaareva.
Mi dame? hatam — beshiura talya milleta. hacha — bikfida talya milleta!
Amar rav yehuda, ema: uleinyan hattumea eno ken.
Amar leh abbaye: ha "vechen leinyan tumea" katane! ella amar abbaye, hachi kaamar: vechen

a: Leinyan tzeruf tumea bappesach, uvishar yemot hashshana ikka pelugeta.

Hechi dame, kegon deikka pachot mikkevetza ochalin, venagu behay batzek. befesach, deissuro chashuv — mitztaref. bishar yemot hashshana, devikfeda talya milleta, im makpid alav — mitztaref, im rotze bekiyyumo — hare hu kaareva.
Matkef la rava: mi katane "mitztaref"? veha "chotzetz" katane. ella amar rava: vechen lehaalot tohora laareva.

Hechi dame, kegon deittammi hach areva, uvae leatbole. befesach, deissuro chashuv — chotzetz, vela salka la tevila. bishar yemot hashshana bikfida talya milleta. i makpid alav — chotzetz, veim rotze bekiyyumo — hare hu kaareva.
Matkef la rav pappa: mi katane "vechen leinyan tohora"? ha "leinyan tumea" katane! ella amar rav pappa: vechen leinyan lehorid tumea laareva.

Hechi dame, kegon denaga sheretz behay batzek. befesach deissuro chashuv — chotzetz, vela nachata la tumea. bishar yemot hashshana devikfida talya, im makpid alav — chotzetz, im rotze bekiyyumo — hare hu kaareva.
Mishna batzek hacheresh, im yesh kayyotze bo shehechmitz — hare ze asur.
Gemara im en sham kayyotze bo mahu? amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: kede sheyyelech adam mimmigdal nunayya litverya mil.
Venema mil! ha ka mashma lan deshiura demil kemimmigdal nunayya vead teverya.
Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: legabbal velitfilla velintilat yadayim — arbaa milin.

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: ayyvu amra, vearbea amar ba, vachada minnayyhu ibbud. ditnan: vechullan sheibbedan, o shehillech bahen kede avoda — tehorin, chutz meor haadam. vechamma kede avoda? amar rabbi (inyay) amar rabbi yannay: kede hilluch arbaa milin.
Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: lo shanu ella lefanav, aval leacharav — afillu mil eno chozer. amar rav acha, uminna: mil — hu deeno chozer, ha pachot mimmil — chozer.
Mishna ketzad mafrishin challa betumea beyom tov?
Rabbi eliezer omer: lo tikra lah shem ad shetteafe. ben betera omer: tatil betzonen. amar rabbi yehoshua:
b: Lo ze hu chametz shemmuzeharin alav beval yerae uveval yimmatze. ella: mafrishatah umannichatah ad haerev, veim hechmitza — hechmitza.
Gemara lema betovat hanaa kamippalgi. derabbi eliezer savar: tovat hanaa mamon. verabbi yehoshua savar: tovat hanaa enah mamon.
La, dechulle alma savri tovat hanaa enah mamon, vehacha behoil" kamippalgi. derabbi eliezer savar: amrinan "hoil", vei bae itteshil ala — mamoneh hu. verabbi yehoshua savar: la amrinan "hoil".
Ittemar: haofe miyyom tov lechol, rav chisda amar: loke, rabba amar: eno loke.
Rav chisda amar loke: la amrinan "hoil umikkali leh orchim — chaze leh". rabba amar eno loke: amrinan "hoil".
Amar leh rabba lerav chisda: ledidach deamrat la amrinan "hoil", heach ofin miyyom tov leshabbat? amar leh: mishshum eruve tavshilin.

Umishshum eruve tavshilin sharenan issura deorayyta?! amar leh: middeorayyta tzorche shabbat naasin beyom tov, verabbanan hu digzaru beh, gezera shemma yomru ofin miyyom tov af lechol. vechevan deatzrechu rabbanan eruve tavshilin — it leh hekkera.

Etiveh: behema hamesukkenet, lo yishchot ella kede sheyyachol leechol hemenna kezayit tzali mibbeod yom. "yachol leechol" — af al gav dela bae lemechal. bishlama ledidi, deamri "hoil": "hoil vei bae lemechal matze achel" — mishshum hachi yishchot. ella ledidach, deamrat la amrinan "hoil", ammay yishchot?
Amar leh: mishshum hefsed mamono. umishshum hefsed mamono sharenan issura deorayyta?!
Amar leh, in: mishshum hefsed mamono — gamar belibbo leechol kezayit, vei efshar lichzayit basar belo shechita.
Etiveh: lechem happanim

a: Neechol letisha, laasara, uleachad asar — lo pachot velo yoter. ketzad? kedarko, letisha. neefe beerev shabbat — neechol beshabbat letisha. chal yom tov lihyot beerev shabbat — neechol leshabbat laasara. shene yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana — neechol leshabbat leachad asar, lefi sheeno doche lo et hashshabbat velo et hayyom tov. vei amrat tzorche shabbat naasin beyom tov, ammay la dache yom tov?
Amar leh: shevut kerova — hittiru. shevut rechoka — lo hittiru.
Ulerabban shimon ben gamliel, deamar mishshum rabbi shimon ben hassegan: doche et yom tov veeno doche et yom tzom, may ikka lememar?
Beha peligi: mar savar shevut kerova hittiru, shevut rechoka lo hittiru. umar savar: shevut rechoka name hittiru.

Metiv rav mari: shete hallechem enan neechalot lo pachot mishshenayim, velo yoter al shelosha. ketzad? neefot erev yom tov — neechalot leyom tov lishnayim. chal yom tov lihyot achar hashshabbat — neechalot leyom tov lishlosha, lefi sheenah docha lo et hashshabbat velo et hayyom tov. vei amrat tzorche shabbat naasin beyom tov, hasheta deshabbat beyom tov shere, deyom tov beyom tov mibbaya?!
Shane hatam deamar kera "lachem" — "lachem" velo legavoah.
Ulerabban shimon ben gamliel, deamar mishshum rabbi shimon ben hassegan: doche et yom tov, may ikka lememar? savar la keabba shaul, deamar: "lachem" — "lachem" velo legoyim.

Shelach leh rav chisda lerabba beyad rav acha bar rav huna: mi amrinan "hoil"? veha tenan: yesh choresh telem echad vechayyayvin aleha mishshum shemona lavin: hachoresh beshor vachamor, vehen mukedashim, vechilayim bakkerem,
b: Usheviit, beyom tov, kohen venazir abbet hattumea. vei amrinan "hoil" — acharisha la lichayyayv, hoil vechaze lechissuy dam tzippor.
Amar rav pappa bar shemuel: baavanim mekurezalot.
Reuyot lechotshan! uchetisha beyom tov mi shere?! reuyot lechotshan kilachar yad! betzunema.
Tzunema bar zeria?! tzunema millemala, veafar tichuach millematta. vetippok leh mishshum afar tichuach!
Ella amar mar bar rav ashe: betina. vetina bar zeria hu?! bimtuneta.

Etiveh abbaye: hamevashshel gid hannashe bechalav beyom tov veochlo — loke chamesh. loke mishshum mevashshel gid beyom tov, veloke mishshum ochel gid, veloke mishshum mevashshel basar bechalav, veloke mishshum ochel basar bechalav, veloke mishshum haveara. vei amrinan "hoil" — ahavara la lichayyayv, hoil dachaze leh letzorko!
Amar leh: appek haveara, veayyel gid hannashe shel nevela.
Vehatane rabbi chiyyay: lokin shetayim al achilato, veshalosh al bishshulo. vei ita, shalosh al achilato mibbee leh!
Ella: appek haveara, veayyel atze muketze.
Umuketze deorayyta hu? amar leh: in, dichtiv: "vehaya bayyom hashshishshi vehechinu et asher yaviu". veazharata mehacha, millo taase chol melacha".
Amar leh, veha at hu daamart: beay minneh merav chisda, veamri la: beay minneh merav huna: hevi se meafar, ushechato tamid beyom tov, mahu?
Veat amrat lan, (amar li) ala: "se" — velo habbechor.
"Achat" — velo maaser.
"Min hatztzon" — velo happalgas.

a: "Min hammatayim" — mimmotar shete meot shennishtayyeyru babbor. mikkan leorla shebbetela bematayim.
"Mimmashke yisrael" — min hammuttar leyisrael. mikkan amru: en meviin nesachin min hattevel.

Yachol lo yavi min hammuketze. amarta: ma tevel meyuchad sheissur gufo garam lo — af kol sheissur gufo garam lo. yatza muketze sheen issur gufo garam lo, ella issur davar acher garam lo. vei amrat issur muketze deorayyta, ma li issur gufo ma li issur davar acher?
Veod, ha at hu deamrat: chilluk melachot leshabbat, veen chilluk melachot leyom tov.
Ella appek haveara, veayyel atze ashera. veazhara mehacha, "velo yidbak beyadcha meuma min hacherem".
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava leabbaye: venilke name mishshum "velo tavi toeva el betecha".
Ella: appek haveara, veayyel atze hekdesh. veazhara mehacha, "vaasherehem tisrefun baesh ... lo taasun ken laAdonai elohechem".
Amar rame bar chama: ha derav chisda verabba — machaloket derabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua hi. derabbi eliezer savar: amrinan "hoil". verabbi yehoshua savar: la amrinan "hoil".

Amar rav pappa: vedilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi eliezer hatam deamrinan "hoil", ella dividdana deka ayyli letannura kol chada vachada chazya leh ledideh. aval hacha, dilorchin hu dachaze ledideh la chaze — ema hachi name dela amrinan "hoil".

Amar rav shisha bereh derav idi: vedilma la hi, ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehoshua hatam dela amrinan "hoil", ella deikka chada dela chazya la ledideh vela leorchin. aval hacha, dachaze mihat leorchin — ema hachi name amrinan "hoil".

Amruha [rabbanan] kammeh derabbi yirmeya verabbi zera. rabbi yirmeya kaybla, rabbi zera la kaybla. amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera: milleta dekashya lan veatya kamma shene bemay peligi rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua, hasheta amruha mishshemeh degavra rabba, vela nikabbela?
Amar leh: hechi akabbela, ditnena, amar leh rabbi yehoshua: lidvarecha, hare hu over mishshum "lo taase chol melacha", ushetek leh. vei ita, lema leh: tama didi mishshum "hoil".

Amar leh: velitamaych, ha ditnena bevarayyta, amar lo rabbi eliezer: lidvarecha, hare hu over mishshum "bal yerae uval yimmatze", ushetek leh. hachi name dela ahdar leh? ha ka mahdar leh bematnitin? ditnan: lo zehu chametz shemmuzeharin alav mishshum "bal yerae uval yimmatze", ella: shatek leh bevarayyta, umahdar leh bematnitin. hachi name, emor shetek leh bematnitin, veahdar leh bimchilta achariti.
Tanya, rabbi omer: halacha kerabbi eliezer, verabbi yitzchak amar: halacha keven betera.
Vechamma shiur issa? rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: bechittin — kabbin. uvisorin — sheloshet kabbin. rabbi natan omer mishshum rabbi eliezer: chilluf haddevarim.
Vehatanya, rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: bechittin — sheloshet kabbin, uvisorin — arbaa kabbin! la kashya: ha — bechassichata, ha — bimalleyayta.
Amar rav pappa: shema minna geriin chitte chassichata mechitte mealleyayta tefe middigrian seare chassichata misseare mealleyayta. deillu hatam tilta, vehacha riva.
Amar rav: kabba melognaa lefischa, vechen lechalla. (vehatanya:)
b: Chameshet revaim kemach veod — chayyayvin bachalla. hachi kaamar, kabba melognae name ahay shiura kae.
Amar rav yosef: hane neshe didan nehug lemefa kefiza kefiza lefischa. amar leh abbaye: may dataych, lechumera? chumera deate lide kulla hu, deka mafka la mechalla.
Amar leh: deavdan kerabbi eliezer, (detanya,) rabbi eliezer omer: harode venoten lassal — hassal metzarfan lachalla. veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi eliezer.
Amar leh: veha ittemar ala, amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: lo shanu ella kikkarot shel bavel shennoshchot zo mizzo, aval keachin — la. ha ittemar ala, amar rabbi chanina: afillu keachin.
Bae rabbi yirmeya: tavla sheen lah levizbezin mahu? toch keli baenan, veha lekka. o dilma — avir keli baenan, veha ikka. teku.
Tanya, rabbi eliezer omer: hassal metzarfan. rabbi yehoshua omer: tannur metzarfan. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer kikkarot shel bavel shennoshchot zo mizzo mitztarfot.
Mishna rabban gamliel omer: shalosh nashim lashot keachat veofot betannur echad, zo achar zo.
Vachachamim omrim: shalosh nashim oskot bevatzek keachat, achat lasha, veachat orechet, veachat ofa.
Rabbi akiva omer: lo kol hannashim velo kol haetzim velo kol hattannurim shavin. ze hakkelal: tafach — tiltosh betzonen.

Gemara tanu rabbanan. lasha, hi mekattefet, vachavertah lasha tachteha. mekattefet, hi ofa, vachavertah mekattefet tachteha, vehashshelishit lasha. ofa hi, lasha, vachavertah ofa tachteha, vehashshelishit mekattefet, vechozrot chalila. kol zeman sheoskot babbatzek — eno ba lide chimmutz.

Rabbi akiva omer lo kol hannashim vechulei. tanya, amar rabbi akiva: danti lifne rabban gamliel, yelammedenu rabbenu benashim zerizot o benashim sheen zerizot? beetzim lachim o beetzim yeveshim? betannur cham o betannur tzonen? amar li: en lecha ella ma sheshshanu chachamim, ze hakkelal: tafach — tiltosh betzonen.
Mishna siur — yissaref, vehaochlo patur. sidduk — yissaref, vehaochlo chayyayv karet.

Ezehu siur? kekarne chagavim. sidduk — shennitarvu sedakin ze baze, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim: ze veze — haochlo chayyayv karet. veezehu siur? kol shehichsifu panav keadam sheamdu saarotav.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: ezehu siur? kol shehichsifu panav keadam sheamdu saarotav. sidduk — kekarne chagavim, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: ezehu siur? kekarne chagavim. sidduk — shennitarvu sedakin ze baze. veze vaze — haochlo chayyayv karet.
Vehaanan tenan: siur yissaref, vehaochlo patur, divre rabbi yehuda. ema: lerabbi meir, ze vaze haochlo chayyayv karet.
Amar rava: may tama derabbi meir — en lach kol sedek vasedek millemala sheen lo kamma sedakim millematta.

a: Mishna arbaa asar shechal lihyot beshabbat — mevaarin et hakkol millifne hashshabbat, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: bizmanno. rabbi eliezer bar tzadok omer: teruma — millifne hashshabbat, vechullin — bizmannan.

Gemara tanya, rabbi eliezer bar tzadok omer: paam achat shavat abba beyavne, vechal arbaa asar lihyot beshabbat. uva zunin memunne shel rabban gamliel veamar: higgia et levaer et hechametz, vehalachti achar abba uviarnu et hechametz.

Mishna haholech lishchot et pischo, velamul et beno, veleechol seudat erusin bevet chamiv, venizkar sheyyesh lo chametz betoch beto. im yachol lachazor ulevaer velachazor lemitzvato — yachzor vivaer, veim lav — mevattelo belibbo.
Lehatztzil min haggoyim, umin hannahar, umin hallistim, umin haddeleka, umin hammappolet — yevattel belibbo. velishbot shevitat harshut — yachzor miyyad.
Vechen mi sheyyatza mirushalayim venizkar sheyyesh beyado besar kodesh, im avar tzofim — sorfo bimkomo. veim lav — chozer vesorfo lifne habbira meatze hammaaracha.
Vead kamma hen chozrin? rabbi meir omer: ze veze bichvetza, rabbi yehuda omer: ze veze bichzayit. vachachamim omrim: besar kodesh — bichzayit, vechametz — bichvetza.
Gemara ureminhu: haholech leechol seudat erusin bevet chamiv, velishbot shevitat harshut — yachzor miyyad!
Amar rabbi yochanan, la kashya: ha — rabbi yehuda, ha — rabbi yose. detanya: seudat erusin reshut, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer: mitzva.
Vehasheta deamar rav chisda: machaloket bisuda sheniyya, aval bisuda rishona divre hakkol mitzva. afillu tema ha veha rabbi yehuda, vela kashya: ha — bisuda rishona, ha — bisuda sheniyya.
Tanya amar rabbi yehuda: ani lo shamati ella seudat erusin, aval lo sivlonot. amar lo rabbi yose: ani shamati seudat erusin vesivlonot.
Tanya, rabbi shimon omer: kol seuda sheenah shel mitzva — en talmid chacham rashshay lehanot mimmenna.
Kegon may? amar rabbi yochanan: kegon bat kohen leyisrael, uvat talmid chacham leam haaretz. deamar rabbi yochanan: bat kohen leyisrael — en ziuugan ole yafe.
May hi? amar rav chisda: o "almana", o "gerusha", o "zera en lah". bematnita tana: kovrah o kovarto, o meviato lide aniyyut.
Ini?! veha amar rabbi yochanan: harotze sheyyitashsher yidbak bezaro shel aharon, kol shekken shettora uchehunna maashartan. la kashya: ha — betalmid chacham, ha — beam haaretz.
Rabbi yehoshua nesev kahenta, chalash. amar: la nicha leh leaharon deedbak bezareh, dehave leh chatna ki ana.
Rav idi bar avin nasev kahenta, nefaku minneh tere bene semichi: rav sheshet bereh derav idi, verabbi yehoshua bereh derav idi. amar rav pappa: i la nasevna kahenta, la iattari.
Amar rav kahana: i la nasevna kahenta, la gelay. amaru leh: veha limkom tora gelet! la gelay kidgale inashe.
Amar rabbi yitzchak: kol hannehene misseudat harshut lesof gole, shenneemar: "veochlim karim mitztzon vaagalim mittoch marbek", uchetiv: "lachen atta yiglu berosh golim".

Tanu rabbanan: kol talmid chacham hammarbe seuddato bechol makom, sof machariv et beto, umealmen et ishto, umeyaytem et gozalav, vetalmudo mishtakkeach mimmennu, umachlokot rabbot baot alav, udevarav enam nishmaim, umechallel shem shamayim veshem rabbo veshem aviv, vegorem shem ra lo ulevanav velivne vanav ad sof kol haddorot.
May hi? amar abbaye: karu leh bar machem tannure. rava amar: bar merakked be chubbe. rav pappa amar: bar melachech pinche. rav shemaya amar: bar mach rava.

Tanu rabbanan: leolam yimkor adam kol ma sheyyesh lo veyissa bat talmid chacham, sheim met o gole — muvetach lo shebbanav talmide chachamim. veal yissa bat am haaretz, sheim met o gole — banav amme haaretz.

Tanu rabbanan: leolam yimkor adam kol ma sheyyesh lo veyissa bat talmid chacham, veyassi bitto letalmid chacham, mashal leinve haggefen beinve haggefen, davar nae umitkabbel. velo yissa bat am haaretz, mashal leinve haggefen beinve hassene, davar kaur
b: Veeno mitkabbel.

Tanu rabbanan: leolam yimkor adam kol ma sheyyesh lo, veyissa bat talmid chacham. lo matza bat talmid chacham — yissa bat gedole haddor. lo matza bat gedole haddor — yissa bat rashe chenesiyyot. lo matza bat rashe chenesiyyot — yissa bat gabbae tzedaka. lo matza bat gabbae tzedaka — yissa bat melammede tinokot. velo yissa bat amme haaretz, mippene shehen sheketz, uneshotehen sheretz, veal benotehen hu omer: "arur shochev im kol behema".

Tanya, rabbi omer: am haaretz asur leechol besar, (behema) shenneemar: "zot torat habbehema vehaof": kol haosek battora muttar leechol besar behema vaof, vechol sheeno osek battora asur leechol basar behema vaof.
Amar rabbi elazar: am haaretz muttar lenochoro beyom hakkippurim shechal lihyot beshabbat. amru lo talmidav: rabbi, emor leshochto! amar lahen: ze taun beracha, veze eno taun beracha.
Amar rabbi elazar: am haaretz asur lehitlauot immo badderech, shenneemar: "ki hi chayyecha veorech yamecha", al chayyav lo chas, al chayye chavero — lo kol shekken.
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yochanan: am haaretz muttar lekoro kedag. amar rabbi shemuel bar yitzchak: umiggabbo.

Tanya, amar rabbi akiva: keshehayiti am haaretz amarti: mi yitten li talmid chacham vaanashshechennu kachamor. amru lo talmidav: rabbi, emor kechelev! amar lahen: ze noshech veshover etzem, veze noshech veeno shover etzem.
Tanya, haya rabbi meir omer: kol hammassi bitto leam haaretz, keillu koftah umannichah lifne ari. ma ari dores veochel, veen lo boshet panim — af am haaretz makke uvoel, veen lo boshet panim.
Tanya, rabbi eliezer omer: ilmale anu tzerichin lahem lemassa umattan, hayu horgin otanu.
Tane rabbi chiyyay: kol haosek battora lifne am haaretz, keillu boel arusato befanav, shenneemar: "tora tzivva lanu moshe morasha". al tikre: "morasha", ella: meorasa.
Gedola sina shessonin amme haaretz letalmid chacham yoter missina shessonin ummot haolam et yisrael, uneshotehen yoter mehen. tana shana uferash, yoter mikkullan.

Tanu rabbanan: shishsha devarim neemru beamme haaretz: en mosrin lahen edut. veen mekabbelin mimmennu edut. veen megallin lahen sod. veen memannin otan appotroppos al hayyetomim. veen memannin otan appotroppos al kuppa shel tzedaka. veen mitlavvin immahen badderech. veyesh omrim: af en machrizin al avedato.
Vetanna kamma? zimnin denafek minneh zara mealleya veachel leh, shenneemar: "yachin vetzaddik yilbash".
Vechen mi sheyyatza vechulei.
Lememra derabbi meir savar kevetza hu dachashiv, verabbi yehuda savar kezayit name chashiv. ureminhi: ad kamma hen mezammenin? ad kezayit, verabbi yehuda omer: ad kevetza!
Amar rabbi yochanan: muchelefet hashshita.

Abbaye amar: leolam la tefoch. hatam — bikrae peligi, hacha — bisvara peligi. hatam bikrae peligi, rabbi meir savar: "veachalta" — zo achila, "vesavata" — zo shetiyya, vaachila bichzayit. verabbi yehuda savar: "veachalta vesavata" — achila sheyyesh bah sevia, veezo zo? bichvetza.
Hacha bisvara peligi, derabbi meir savar chazarato ketumeato: ma tumeato bichvetza, af chazarato bichvetza. verabbi yehuda savar chazarato

a: Keissuro: ma issuro bichzayit, af chazarato bichzayit.
Tanya, rabbi natan omer: ze veze kishte vetzim, velo hodu lo chachamim.
"Vehaya bayyom hahu lo yihye or yekarot vekippaon". may "yekarot vekippaon"?
Amar rabbi elazar: ze or sheyyakar baolam hazze, vekafuy laolam habba.
Rabbi yochanan amar: ellu negaim veohalot, sheyyekarin hen baolam hazze, ukefuyin hen laolam habba.

Verabbi yehoshua ben levi amar: ellu bene adam sheyyekarin hen baolam hazze, ukefuyin hen laolam habba. ki ha derav yosef bereh derabbi yehoshua ben levi chalash veitnegid, ki hadar, amar leh avu: may chazet? amar leh: olam hafuch raiti, elyonim lematta, vetachtonim lemala. amar lo: beni, olam barur raita. vaanan hechi hatam? ki hechi deitu anan hacha, hachi itinan hatam.
Veshamati shehayu omrim: ashre mi shebba lechan vetalmudo beyado. veshamati shehayu omrim: haruge malchut en adam yachol laamod bimchitzatan.
(Uman) ninhu? ilema rabbi akiva vachaverav — mishshum haruge malchut vetu la?! ella: haruge lod.
"Bayyom hahu yihye al metzillot hassus kodesh laAdonai". may "metzillot hassus"?
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: atid hakkadosh baruch hu lehosif al yerushalayim ad shehassus ratz umetzel.
Rabbi elazar amar: kol metzillot shettolin lassus ben enav — yihye kodesh laAdonai.
Verabbi yochanan amar: kol bizza shebbozzin yisrael ad shaa shehassus ratz umetzel — yihye kodesh laAdonai.

Bishlama leman deamar kol bizza shebbazzu yisrael, hayeynu dichtiv: "vehaya hassirot bevet Adonai kammizrakim lifne hammizbeach". ella leman deamar behanach tarte, may "vehaya hassirot bevet Adonai"? milleta achariti kaamar, demitatteri yisrael umitnaddevi umayyti.
Bishlama leman deamar bizza, hayeynu dichtiv: "velo yihye chenaani od bevet Adonai tzevaot". ella leman deamar hanach tarte, may "velo yihye chenaani"? amar rabbi yirmeya: en kan ani.

Uchenaani menalan deikkeri taggar? dichtiv: "vayyar sham yehuda bat ish kenaani". may "kenaani"? illema kenaani mammash, efshar ba avraham vehizhir et yitzchak, ba yitzchak vehizhir et yaakov, vihuda azel venasev?! ella amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: bat gavra taggara, dichtiv: "kenaan beyado mozne mirma". veibbaet ema mehacha: "asher sochareha sarim kinaneha nichbadde aretz".
"Vehaya Adonai lemelech al kol haaretz bayyom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad". attu haiddana lav echad hu?

Amar rabbi acha bar chanina: lo kaolam hazze haolam habba. haolam hazze, al besorot tovot omer: "baruch hattov vehammetiv", veal besorot raot omer: "baruch dayyayn haemet". laolam habba, kullo "hattov vehammetiv".
"Ushemo echad". may "echad"? attu haiddana lav shemo echad hu?
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: lo kaolam hazze haolam habba. haolam hazze, nichtav beyod he venikra bealef dalet. aval laolam habba kullo echad, nikra beyod he venichtav beyod he.
Sevar rava lemidresha befirka, amar leh hahu sava: "leallem" ketiv.
Rabbi avina rame: ketiv "ze shemi leolam" — "veze zichri ledor dor". amar hakkadosh baruch hu: lo kesheani nichtav, ani nikra. nichtav ani beyod he, venikra ani bealef dalet.
Haderan alach ellu ovrin

Mishna makom shennahagu laasot melacha bearve fesachim ad chatzot — osin. makom shennahagu shello laasot — en osin. haholech mimmakom sheosin lemakom sheen osin, o mimmakom sheen osin lemakom sheosin — notnin alav chumere makom sheyyatza mishsham vechumere makom shehalach lesham.
b: Veal yeshanne adam mippene hammachaloket. kayyotze bo: hammolich perot sheviit mimmakom shekkalu limkom shello kalu, o mimmakom shello kalu lemakom shekkalu — chayyayv levaer. rabbi yehuda omer: tze vehave lecha af atta.

Gemara may irya arve fesachim? afillu arve shabbatot vearve yamim tovim name! detanya: haose melacha bearve shabbatot veyamim tovim min hammincha ulemala eno roe siman beracha leolam! hatam, min hammincha ulemala hu deasur, samuch lammincha — la. hacha — mechatzot. i name: hatam, siman beracha hu dela chaze, aval shammote la meshammetinan leh. hacha — shammote name meshammetinan leh.

Gufa: haose melacha bearve shabbatot uvearve yamim tovim min hammincha ulemala, uvemotzae shabbat uvemotzae yom tov uvemotzae yom hakkippurim, uvechol makom sheyyesh sham nidnud avera, leetoye taanit tzibbur — eno roe siman beracha leolam.

Tanu rabbanan: yesh zariz veniskar, veyesh zariz venifsad. yesh shafal veniskar, veyesh shafal venifsad. zariz veniskar — deaved kulle shabbeta, vela aved bemaale shabbeta. zariz venifsad — deaved kulle shabbeta, veaved bemaale shabbeta. shafal veniskar — dela aved kulle shabbeta, vela aved bemaale shabbeta. shafal venifsad — dela aved kulle shabbeta, veaved bemaale shabbeta. amar rava: hane neshe demachoza, af al gav dela avdan avidta bemaale shabbeta — mishshum mefannekuta hu, deha kol yoma name la ka avdan. afillu hachi — shafal veniskar karenan lehu.

Rava rame: ketiv "ki gadol ad shamayim chasdecha", uchetiv "ki gadol meal shamayim chasdecha". ha ketzad? kan beosin lishmah, vechan beosin shello lishmah. vechidrav yehuda. deamar rav yehuda amar rav: leolam yaasok adam betora umitzvot af al pi shello lishmah, shemmittoch shello lishmah ba lishmah.

Tanu rabbanan: hametzappe lischar ishto verechayim — eno roe siman beracha leolam. sechar ishto — matkuleta. richyay — agrata. aval avda umezabbena — ishtabboche mishtabbach bah kera dichtiv: "sadin asta vattimkor".

Tanu rabbanan: hammistakker bekanim uvekankannim — eno roe siman beracha leolam. may tama? kevan dinfish afchazayyhu — shalta behu ena. tanu rabbanan: taggare simta, umegaddele behema dakka, vekotztze ilanot tovot, venotnin enehen bechelek yafe — eno roe siman beracha leolam, may tama? detahu beh inashe.
Tanu rabbanan, arba perutot en bahen siman beracha leolam: sechar kotvin, usechar meturegmanin, usechar yetomim, umaot habbaot mimmedinat hayyam.
Bishlama sechar meturegmanin — mishshum demichaze kischar shabbat. umaot yetomim name — lav bene mechila ninhu. maot habbaot mimmedinat hayyam — mishshum delav kol yoma mitrechish nissa.

Ella sechar kotvin may tama? amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: esrim vearba taaniyyot yashvu anshe keneset haggedola al kotve sefarim tefillin umezuzot shello yitashsheru, sheilmale mitashsherin — en kotvin. tanu rabbanan: kotve sefarim tefillin umezuzot, hen, vetaggarehen, vetaggare taggarehen, vechol haoskin bimlechet shamayim, leetoye mochre techelet — enan roin siman beracha leolam. veim oskin lishmah — roin.

Bene vayyshan nehug dela havo azlin mitztzor letzidon bemaale shabbeta. ato benayyhu kammeh derabbi yochanan, amru lo: avahatin efshar lehu, anan la efshar lan. amar lehu: kevar kibbelu avotechem alehem, shenneemar: "shema beni musar avicha veal tittosh torat immecha".
Bene chozae nahagi demafreshi challa mearoza, ato vaamaru leh lerav yosef. amar lehu: nechla zar beappayyhu. etiveh abbaye: devarim hammuttarim vaacherim nahagu bahen issur —

a: I atta rashshay lehattiran bifnehem. amar lo: velav mi ittemar ala, amar rav chisda: bechutae! kutae may tama — mishshum dimsarchi milleta, hanach inashe name sarchi milleta.

Ella amar rav ashe: chazenan i rubban orez achli — la nechla zar beappayyhu, dilma mishtachcha torat challa minnayyhu. vei rubban dagan achli — nechla zar beappayyhu, dilma ate leafroshe min hachiyyuv al happetur, umin happetur al hachiyyuv.

Gufa, devarim hammuttarin vaacherim nahagu bahen issur — i atta rashshay lehattiran bifnehen. amar rav chisda: bechutae askinan. vechulle alma la? vehatanya: rochatzin shene achin keechad, veen rochatzin shene achin bechavul. umaase bihuda vehillel banav shel rabban gamliel sherachatzu shenehem keechad bechavul, velaaza alehen kol hammedina, amru: miyyamenu lo rainu kach. venishmat hillel veyatza labbayit hachitzon, velo ratza lomar lahen: muttarin attem.

Yotzim bekordakeson bashshabbat, veen yotzin bekordakeson bashshabbat bevere. umaase bihuda vehillel banav shel rabban gamliel sheyyatzu bekordakeson bashshabbat bevere, velaaza alehen hammedina, veamru: miyyamenu lo rainu kach. ushematum unetanum leavdehen, velo ratzu lomar lahen: muttarin attem.

Veyoshvin al safsalle goyim bashshabbat, veenan yoshvin al safsalle goyim bashshabbat beakko. umaase berabban shimon ben gamliel sheyyashav al safsalle goyim bashshabbat beakko, velaaza alav kol hammedina, amru: miyyamenu lo rainu kach. nishmat al gabbe karka, velo ratza lomar lahen: muttarin attem. bene medinat hayyam name, kevan dela shechichi rabbanan gabbayyhu — kechutim damu.
Bishlama safsalle goyim, mishshum demichaze kemikkach umimkar. bekordakeson name, dilma mishtallefin veate leetoyinhu arba ammot birshut harabbim.
Ella rochatzin may tama la? kidtanya: im hakkol adam rochetz, chutz meaviv vechamiv uvaal immo uvaal achoto. verabbi yehuda mattir beaviv mippene kevod aviv, vehu haddin levaal immo.
Vaato inhu ugezur bishne achin mishshum baal achoto. tana: talmid lo yirchatz im rabbo, veim rabbo tzarich lo — muttar.
Ki ata rabba bar bar chana, achal deayyitra. ul legabbeh rav avvira sava verabba bereh derav huna, kevan dachazinhu kasseyeh minnayyhu. ato vaamaru leh leabbaye. amar lehu: shavivynchu kechutae.

Verabba bar bar chana let leh ha ditnan notnin alav chumere hammakom sheyyatza mishsham vechumere hammakom shehalach lesham? amar abbaye: hane mille mibbavel levavel, umeeretz yisrael leeretz yisrael. i name, mibbavel leeretz yisrael. aval meeretz yisrael levavel — la. kevan daanan kayyfinan lehu, avdinan kevotayyhu.

Rav ashe amar: afillu tema meeretz yisrael levavel, hane mille hecha deen dato lachazor, verabba bar bar chana dato lachazor hava. amar leh rabba bar bar chana livneh: beni, lo tochal lo befanay velo shello befanay. ani sheraiti et rabbi yochanan sheachal — keday hu rabbi yochanan lismoch alav befanav veshello befanav. atta lo raita oto, lo tochal ben befanay ben shello befanay.
Vfliga dideh addideh. deamar rabba bar bar chana, sach li rabbi yochanan ben elazar: paam achat nichnasti achar rabbi shimon ben rabbi yose ben lakonya lagginna,
b: Venatal sefiche cheruv veachal venatan li, veamar li: beni, befanay — echol, shello befanay — lo tochal. ani sheraiti et rabbi shimon ben yochay sheachal — keday hu rabbi shimon ben yochay lismoch alav befanav veshello befanav. atta — befanay echol, shello befanay — lo tochal.
May rabbi shimon? detanya: rabbi shimon omer: kol hassefichim asurin, chutz missefiche keruv, sheen kayyotze bahen beyarak hassade. vachachamim omrim: kol hassefichin asurim.
Vetarvayyhu allibba derabbi akiva. detanya: "hen lo nizra velo neesof et tevuatenu", amar rabbi akiva: vechi meachar sheen zorin mehecha osfin? mikkan lassefichin shehen asurin.
Bemay ka mippalgi? rabbanan savri: gazrinan sefiche cheruv attu shear sefiche dealma, verabbi shimon savar: la gazrinan sefiche cheruv attu sefiche dealma.
Haholech mimmakom vechulei. bishlama haholech mimmakom sheosin lemakom sheen osin — notnin alav chumere makom shehalach lesham, veal yeshanne adam mippene hammachloket vela lebed.
Ella mimmakom sheen osin lemakom sheosin, al yeshanne adam mippene hammachloket venabed? ha amrat: "notnin alav chumere makom shehalach lesham vechumere makom sheyyatza mishsham"!
Amar abbaye: aresha. rava amar: leolam assefa, vehachi kaamar: en bazo mippene shinnuy hammachloket. may ka amrat — haroe omer melacha asura? memar amri: kamma batlane have beshuka.
Amar leh rav safra lerabbi abba: kegon anan deyadinan bikvia deyarcha,

a: Bayyishshuv la avedna mippene shinnuy hammachloket. bammidbar may? amar leh: hachi amar rav amme: bayyishshuv asur, bammidbar muttar.

Rav natan bar asya azal mibbe rav lefumebdita beyom tov sheni shel atzeret. shamteh rav yosef. amar leh abbaye: ulenaggedeh mar naggoyde! amar leh: adifa avadi leh, divmareva mimmenu annigyda devar be rav, vela mimmenu ashshamta.

Ikka deamri: naggedeh rav yosef. amar leh abbaye: neshammeteh mar, derav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu menaddin al shene yamim tovim shel galiyyot! amar leh: hane mille — inish dealma. hacha, tzureba midderabbanan hu — detava leh avadi. divmareva mimmenu annigdeta devar be rav, vela mimmenu ashshamta.
Kayyotze bo hammolich perot sheviit vechulei. velet leh lerabbi yehuda ha ditnan: notnin alav chumere hammakom sheyyatza mishsham vechumere hammakom shehalach lesham?!

Amar rav shisha bereh derav idi: milleta achariti kaamar rabbi yehuda, vehachi kaamar: o mimmakom shello kalu lemakom shello kalu, veshama shekkalu bimkomo — chayyayv levaer. rabbi yehuda omer: tze vehave lecha af atta mehecha deayytinhu, veha la kalu lehu.

Lememra derabbi yehuda lekulla kaamar? vehaamar rabbi elazar: lo amar rabbi yehuda ella lechumera! ella efoch — eno chayyayv levaer, rabbi yehuda omer: tze vehave lecha af atta mehecha deayytinhu, veha kalu lehu.

Abbaye amar: leolam kidkatane, vehachi kaamar: o mimmakom shello kalu lemakom shekkalu, vehechziran limkoman vaadayin lo kalu — eno chayyayv levaer, rabbi yehuda omer: tze vehave lecha af atta mehecha deayytinhu, veha kalu lehu.

Matkef la rav ashe: lerabbi yehuda attu aggabba dechamra kaltinhu?! ella amar rav ashe: biflugeta dehane tannae, ditnan: hakkovesh shelosha kevashin bechavit achat, rabbi elazar omer: ochlin al harishon.
Rabbi yehoshua omer: af al haacharon. rabban gamliel omer: kol shekkala mino min hassade — yevaer mino min hechavit, vahalacha kidvarav.
Ravina amar: biflugeta dehane tannae, ditnan: ochlin bitmarin ad sheyyichle haacharon shebbetzoar. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer:
b: Ochlin al shel ben hakkippin, veen ochlin al shebben hashshitzin.

Tenan hatam, shalosh aratzot leviur: yehuda, veever hayyarden, vegalil. veshalosh aratzot bechol achat veachat. velama amru shalosh aratzot leviur? sheyyihyu ochlin bechol achat veachat ad sheyyichle haacharon shebbah.

Mena hane mille? amar rav chama bar ukeva amar rabbi yose bar chanina: amar kera "velivhemtecha velachayya asher beartzecha". kol zeman shechayya ochelet min hassade — haachel labbehema shebbabbayit, kala lechayya asher bassade — kalle livhemtecha min habbayit.
Ugemiri: deen chayya shebbihuda gedela al perot shebbaggalil, veen chayya shebbaggalil gedela al perot shebbihuda.

Tanu rabbanan: perot sheyyatzu meeretz yisrael lechutza laaretz — mitbaarin bechol makom shehen. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: yachzeru limkoman veyitbaaru, mishshum shenneemar: "beartzecha". ha appekteh?
Keri beh: "baaretz" "beartzecha", i name: "measher beartzecha".

Rav safra nefak meeretz yisrael lechutza laaretz. hava bahadeh garba dechamra dishviit, lauo bahadeh rav huna bereh derav ika verav kahana, amar lehu: ikka dishmia leh minneh derabbi avahu halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar o la? amar leh rav kahana, hachi amar rabbi avahu: halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar. amar leh rav huna bereh derav ika, hachi amar rabbi avahu: en halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar.

Amar rav safra: nekot ha kelala derav huna bidach, dedayek vegamar shematata mippummeh derabbeh kerachava defumebdita. deamar rachava amar rav yehuda: har habbayit setav kaful haya setav lefanim missetav. kare aleh rav yosef: "ammi beetzo yishal umaklo yaggid lo". kol hammekel lo — maggid lo.

Rabbi ilay katz kafneyayta dishviit. hechi aved hachi?! "leochla" amar rachamana, velo lehefsed. vechi tema: hane mille hecha denachet lefera, aval hecha dela nachet lefera — la. vehaamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: hane metachale deorla — asiri, hoil venaasu shomer lefere.
Veshomer lefere immat have? bechufere veka kare lehu pere! rav nachman deamar kerabbi yose. ditnan, rabbi yose omer: semadar asur, mippene shehu pere, ufeligi rabbanan aleh.

Matkef la rav shimi minnehardea: umi peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi yose bishar ilanot? veha tenan: meematay en kotztzin et hailanot bashsheviit? bet shammay omrim: kol hailanot mishsheyyotziu, uvet hillel omrim: hecharuvin mishsheyyesharsheru, vehaggefanim

a: Mishsheyyegareu, vehazzetim mishsheyyanetzu, ushear kol hailanot mishsheyyotziu. veamar rav assi: hu boser, hu gerua, hu pol hallavan. pol hallavan salka datach?! ella ema: shiuro kefol hallavan.
Uman shamat leh deamar boser in, semadar la — rabbanan, vekatane: shear kol hailanot mishsheyyotziu! ella rabbi ilay bidnischane katz.
Tanu rabbanan: ochlin baanavim ad sheyyichlu daliyyot shel ochel. im yesh meucharot mehen — ochlin alehen.

Ochlim bezetim ad sheyyichle acharon shebbitkoa, rabbi eliezer omer: ad sheyyichle acharon shel gush chalav, kede sheyyehe ani yotze veeno motze lo benofo velo beikkaro rova. ochlin bigrogrot ad sheyyichlu pagge bet hine.
Amar rabbi yehuda: lo huzekru pagge bet hine ella leinyan maaser. (ditnan:) pagge bet hine vaahine detovina — chayyayvin bemaaser.
Ochlin bitmarim ad sheyyichle haacharon shebbetzoar. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: ochlin al shel ben hakkippin, veen ochlin al shel ben hashshitzin.

Ureminhi: ochlin baanavim ad happesach, bezetim ad haatzeret, bigrogrot ad hachanukka, bitmarim ad happurim, veamar rav bivi: rabbi yochanan tarte batrayayta — machlif. idde veidde chad shiura hu. vei baet ema, ha katane behedya: im yesh meucharot mehen — ochlin alehen.

Tanya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: siman leharim — melin. siman laamakim — dekalim. siman linchalim — kanim. siman lashshefela — shikma. veaf al pi sheen reaya ledavar, zecher laddavar, shenneemar: "vayyitten hammelech et hakkesef birushalaym kaavanim veet haarazim natan kashshikmim asher bashshefela larov".
Siman leharim melin, siman laamakim dekalim — nafka minna levikkurim, ditnan: en meviin bikkurim ella mishshivat hamminin, velo middekalim shebbeharim, velo mipperot shebbaamakim.
Siman linchalim kanim — nafka minna lenachal etan. siman lashshefela shikma — nafka minna lemikkach umimkar. hasheta deatet lehachi, kullehu name lemikkach umimkar.

Mishna makom shennahagu limkor behema dakka laggoyim — mochrin, makom shello nahagu limkor — en mochrin. uvechol makom en mochrin lahem behema gassa, agalim useyaychin, shelemin ushevurin. rabbi yehuda mattir bashshevura. ben betira mattir bassus.
Makom shennahagu leechol tzali belele fesachim — ochlin, makom shennahagu shello leechol — en ochlin.

Gemara amar rav yehuda amar rav: asur lo leadam sheyyomar "basar ze lefesach hu" — mippene shennire kemakdish behemto veochel kadashim bachutz. amar rav pappa: davka basar, aval chitte — la, demintar lefischa kaamar.

Uvasar la? metivi amar rabbi yose: todos ish romi hinhig et bene romi leechol gedayim mekullasin belele pesachim. shalchu lo: ilmale todos atta gazarnu alecha nidduy, sheatta maachil et yisrael kadashim bachutz. "kadashim" salka datach! ella ema:
b: Karov lehaachil et yisrael kadashim bachutz. mekullas — in, sheen mekullas — la! amri, mekullas: la shena amar, la shena la amar. sheeno mekullas: peresh — in, lo peresh — la.
Rav acha matni la leha matnitin kerabbi shimon. matkef la rav sheshet: bishlama leman detane la kerabbi yose — nicha, ella leman dematne kerabbi shimon — mi nicha?
Vehatnan: rabbi shimon poter, shello hitnaddev kederech hammitnaddevim.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: uman dematne la kerabbi yose mi nicha? vehaamar rava: rabbi shimon beshitat rabbi yose amarah, deamar: af bigmar devarav adam nitpas.
May lav: midderabbi shimon savar la kerabbi yose, rabbi yose name savar la kerabbi shimon! la, rabbi shimon savar la kerabbi yose, vela rabbi yose savar la kerabbi shimon.
Ibbaya lehu: todos ish romi gavra rabba hava, o baal egrofin hava?
Ta shema. od zo darash todos ish romi: ma rau chananya mishael vaazarya shemmasru [atzman] al kedushshat hashshem lechivshan haesh?

Nasu kal vachomer beatzman mitztzefardeim. uma tzefardeim sheen metzuvvivyn al kedushshat hashshem, ketiv behu: "uvau [vealu] bevetecha [vegomer] uvetannurecha uvemisharotecha", ematay misharot metzuyot etzel tannur? heve omer beshaa shehattannur cham. anu shemmetzuvvivyn al kedushshat hashshem — al achat kamma vechamma.

Rabbi yose bar avin amar: metil melay lechis shel talmide chachamim haya. deamar rabbi yochanan: kol hammetil melay lechis talmide chachamim zoche veyoshev bishiva shel mala, shenneemar: "ki betzel hachochma betzel hakkasef".

Mishna makom shennahagu lehadelik et hanner belele yom hakkippurim — madlikin. makom shennahagu shello lehadelik — en madlikin. umadlikin bevatte chenesiyyot uvevatte midrashot uvimvoot haafelim veal gabbe hacholim.

Gemara tana: ben sheamru lehadelik uven sheamru shello lehadelik — shenehen ledavar echad nitkavvevnu. amar rav yehoshua: daresh rava "veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz vegomer", ben sheamru lehadelik uven sheamru shello lehadelik — shenehem lo nitkavvevnu ella ledavar echad.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: en mevarchin al haur ella bemotzae shabbat, hoil utechillat beriyyayto hu. amar leh hahu sava, veittema rabba bar bar chana: yishar, vechen amar rabbi yochanan. ulla hava rechiv chamara veazel, vahava shakel veazel rabbi abba miyyammineh verabba bar bar chana missemaleh. amar leh rabbi abba leulla: vadday deamritu mishshemeh derabbi yochanan "en mevarchin al haur ella bemotzae shabbat, hoil utechillat beriyyayto hu".

Hadar ulla, chaza beh berabba bar bar chana bishut. amar leh: ana lav aha amari, ella aha amri — detane tanna kammeh derabbi yochanan, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: yom hakkippurim shechal lihyot beshabbat, af bemakom sheamru shello lehadelik — madlikin mippene kevod hashshabbat. veane rabbi yochanan batreh: vachachamim osrim. amar leh: ada tehe.
Kare aleh rav yosef: "mayim amukkim etza velev ish

a: Veish tevuna yidlenna". "mayim amukkim etza velev ish" — ze ulla. "veish tevuna yidlenna" — ze rabba bar bar chana. veinhu keman savruha? ki ha deamar rabbi binyamin bar yefet amar rabbi yochanan: mevarchin al haur ben bemotzae shabbat ben bemotzae yom hakkippurim. vechen amma davar.

Metivi: en mevarchin al haur ella bemotzae shabbat, hoil utechillat beriyyayto hu. vechevan sheroe — mevarech miyyad. rabbi yehuda omer, sodran al hakkos. veamar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabbi yehuda!
La kashya: kan beur sheshshavat, kan beur hayyotze min haetzim umin haavanim.
Tane chada: ur hayyotze min haetzim umin haavanim mevarchin alav, vetane chada: en mevarchin alav. la kashya: kan bemotzae shabbat, kan bemotzae yom hakkippurim.
Rabbi mefazzeran. rabbi chiyyay mechannesan. amar rabbi yitzchak bar avdimi: af al pi sherabbi mefazzeran — chozer vesodran al hakkos, kede lehotzi banav uvene beto.

Veur bemotzae shabbat ibberi? veha tanya: asara devarim nivreu beerev shabbat ben hashshemashot, ellu hen: beer, vehamman, vekeshet, ketav, umachtev, vehalluchot, vekivro shel moshe, umeara sheamad bo moshe veeliyyahu, petichat pi haaton, ufetichat pi haaretz livloa et harshaim.

Rabbi nechemya omer mishshum aviv: af haur vehappered. rabbi yoshiyya omer mishshum aviv: af haayil, vehashshamir. rabbi yehuda omer: af hatztzevat. hu haya omer: tzevata bitzvata mitavda, utzevata kammayyta man avad? ha laye beriyya bide shamayim hi. amar leh: efshar yaasenna bidfus veyikbaenna kevan. ha laye beriyya bide adam hi.

La kashya: ha beur didan, ha beur degehinnam. ur didan — bemotzae shabbat, ur degehinnam — beerev shabbat. veur degehinnam beerev shabbat ibberi? veha tanya: shiva devarim nivreu kodem shennivra haolam, veellu hen: tora, uteshuva, vegan eden, vegehinnam, vechisse hakkavod, uvet hammikdash, ushemo shel mashiach.
Tora, dichtiv: "Adonai kanani reshit darko". teshuva, dichtiv: "beterem harim yulladu", uchetiv: "tashev enosh ad dakka vattomer shuvu vene adam".
Gan eden, dichtiv: "vayyitta Adonai elohim gan beeden mikkedem". gehinnam, dichtiv: "ki aruch meetmul tofte".
Kisse hakkavod uvet hammikdash, dichtiv: "kisse chavod marom merishon mekom mikdashenu". shemo shel mashiach, dichtiv: "yehi shemo leolam lifne shemesh yinnon shemo"!
Amri, chalalah hu denivra kodem shennivra haolam, veur dideh beerev shabbat.

Veur dideh beerev shabbat ibberi? vehattanya, rabbi yose omer: ur shebbara hakkadosh baruch hu besheni bashshabbat en lo keviyyay leolam, shenneemar: "veyatzu verau befigre haanashim happoshim bi ki tolatam lo tamut veishsham lo tichbe", veamar rabbi benaa bereh derabbi ulla: mippene ma lo neemar "ki tov" besheni bashshabbat — mippene shennivra bo ur shel gehinnam. veamar rabbi elazar: af al pi shello neemar bo "ki tov", chazar uchelalo bashshishshi, shenneemar: "vayyar elohim et kol asher asa vehinne tov meod".

Ella: chalalah — kodem shennivra haolam, veur dideh — besheni bashshabbat. veur didan — bemachshava ala libbarot beerev shabbat, velo nivra ad motzae shabbat. detanya, rabbi yose omer: shene devarim alu bemachshava libbarot beerev shabbat, velo nivreu ad motzae shabbat, uvemotzae shabbat natan hakkadosh baruch hu dea beadam harishon meen dugema shel mala, vehevi shene avanim utechanan zo bazo, veyatza mehen ur, vehevi shete vehemot vehirkiv zo bazo veyatza mehen pered. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: pered bime ana haya, shenneemar: "hu ana asher matza et hayyemim bammidbar".

Dorshe chamurot, hayu omrim: ana pasul haya, lefichach hevi pesul leolam, shenneemar: "elle vene seir hachori", uchetiv: "elle vene tzivon veayya vaana"! ella, melammed shebba tzivon al immo veholid mimmenna ana.

Vedilma tere ana havo?! amar rava: amena milleta deshabbur malka la amra, umannu? shemuel. ikka deamri: amar rav pappa: amena milleta deshabbur malka la amra, umannu? rava; amar kera: "hu ana" — hu ana demeikkara.

Tanu rabbanan: asara devarim nivreu beerev shabbat ben hashshemashot, veellu hen: beer, uman, vekeshet, hakketav, vehammachtev, vehalluchot, kivro shel moshe, umeara sheamad bah moshe veeliyyahu, petichat pi haaton, ufetichat pi haaretz livloa et harshaim. veyesh omrim: af maklo shel aharon shekedeha uferacheha, veyesh omrim: af hammazzikin, veyesh omrim: af
b: Bigdo shel adam harishon.

Tanu rabbanan: shiva devarim mechussim mibbene adam, ellu hen: yom hammita, veyom hannechama, veomek haddin, veen adam yodea ma belibbo shel chavero, veen adam yodea bamme mistakker, umalchut bet david matay tachzor, umalchut chayyevet matay tichle.

Tanu rabbanan: shelosha devarim alu bemachshava libbarot, veim lo alu — din hu sheyyaalu: al hammet sheyyasriach. veal hammet sheyyishtakkeach min hallev. veal hattevua shetterakev. veyesh omrim: al hammatbea sheyyetze.

Mishna makom shennahagu laasot melacha betisha beav — osin, makom shennahagu shello laasot melacha — en osin, uvechol makom talmide chachamim betelim. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: leolam yaase adam atzmo talmid chacham.
