Gemara amar shemuel: en taanit tzibbur bevavel ella tisha beav bilvad. lememra desavar shemuel tisha beav ben hashshemashot shello asur? vehaamar shemuel: tisha beav ben hashshemashot shello muttar. vechi tema kasavar shemuel: kol taanit tzibbur ben hashshemashot shello muttar, vehaanan tenan: "ochlin veshotin mibbeod yom". lemaote may, lav lemaote ben hashshemashot? la, lemaote mishshechashecha.
Nema mesayyay leh: en ben tisha beav leyom hakkippurim, ella shezze sefeko asur, veze sefeko muttar.
May sefeko muttar — lav ben hashshemashot? la, kidamar rav shisha bereh derav idi: likvia deyarcha, hacha name — likvia deyarcha.

Daresh rava: ubbarot umenikot — mitannot umashlimot bo, kederech shemmitannot umashlimot beyom hakkippurim, uven hashshemashot shello asur. vechen amru mishshemeh derabbi yochanan. umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? vehaamar rabbi yochanan: tisha beav eno ketaanit tzibbur. may lav, leven hashshemashot? lo, limlacha.

Melacha? tenena: makom shennahagu laasot melacha betisha beav — osin, uvemakom shennahagu shello laasot — en osin. vaafillu rabban shimon ben gamliel la amar ella dechi yatev vela aved, la michze keyuhara, aval mesar — la asar.
Ella: may eno ketaanit tzibbur — litfillat neila. vehaamar rabbi yochanan: ulevay sheyyitpallel adam veholech kol hayyom kullo!
Hatam chova, hacha reshut. veibbaet ema: may eno ketaanit tzibbur — leesrim vearbaa.
Rav pappa amar: may "eno ketaanit tzibbur" — eno karishonot, ella kaacharonot, vaasura.

Metivi: en ben tisha beav leyom hakkippurim ella shezze sefeko asur veze sefeko muttar, may sefeko muttar — lav ben hashshemashot shello! amar rav shisha bereh derav idi: la, likvia deyarcha, ha lechol devarim — ze vaze shavin.
Mesayyay lerabbi elazar, deamar rabbi elazar: asur lo leadam sheyyoshit etzbao bemayim betisha beav, kederech sheasur lehoshit etzbao beyom hakkippurim.

Metivi: en ben tisha beav letaanit tzibbur ella shezze asur baasiyyayt melacha veze muttar baasiyyayt melacha bimkom shennahagu. ha lechol divrehem — ze vaze shavin. veillu gabbe taanit tzibbur tanya: kesheamru "asur birchitza", lo amru ella kol gufo, aval panav yadav veraglav — lo!
Amar rav pappa:

a: Tanna kulle kulle katane.

Uvechol makom talmide chachamim vechulei. lememra derabban shimon ben gamliel savar: la chayyshinan leyuhara, verabbanan savri: chayyshinan leyuhara? veha ippecha shaminan lehu, ditnan: chatan, im yirtze likrot keriyyat shema layla harishon — kore. rabban shimon ben gamliel amar: lo kol harotze littol et hashshem yittol.

Amar rabbi yochanan: muchelefet hashshita. rav shisha bereh derav idi amar la tefoch: derabbanan adderabbanan la kashya; hacha, kevan dechulle alma avdi melacha veihu la aved — michze keyuhara, aval hatam, kevan dechulle alma kare veihu name kare — la michze keyuhara.

Derabban shimon ben gamliel adderabban shimon ben gamliel la kashya; hatam hu devaenan kauona, vaanan sahade dela matze kauone dateh — michze keyuhara: aval hacha la michze keyuhara, amri: melacha hi delet leh, pok chazi kamma batlane ikka beshuka.
Mishna vachachamim omrim: bihuda hayu osin melacha bearve fesachim ad chatzot, uvaggalil lo hayu osin kol ikkar. hallayla, bet shammay osrim, uvet hillel mattirin ad hanetz hachamma.
Gemara meikkara tena minhaga, ulevassof tena issura!

Amar rabbi yochanan, la kashya: ha — rabbi meir, ha — rabbi yehuda. detanya, amar rabbi yehuda: bihuda hayu osin melacha bearve fesachim ad chatzot, uvaggalil enan osin kol ikkar. amar lo rabbi meir: ma reayay yehuda vegalil lechan? ella, makom shennahagu laasot melacha — osin, makom shennahagu shello laasot — en osin. middekaamar rabbi meir minhaga — mikkelal derabbi yehuda issura kaamar.
Vesavar rabbi yehuda arbaa asar muttar baasiyyayt melacha? vehatanya, rabbi yehuda omer: hamenakkesh bishlosha asar venekera beyado — shotlah bimkom hattit, veen shotlah bimkom haggerid.

Bishlosha asar — in, bearbaa asar — la. mikkedi shaminan leh lerabbi yehuda deamar: kol harekava sheenah koletet lishlosha yamim — shuv enah koletet. vei salka datach arbaa asar muttar baasiyyayt melacha, lema li shelosha asar? vehaikka arbesar vachamesar umiktzat shittesar! amar rava: baggalil shanu.
Vehaikka lelya! amar rav sheshet: kevet shammay. rav ashe amar: leolam kevet hillel — lefi sheen darkan shel bene adam lenakkesh ballayla.
Ravina amar: leolam bihuda, uvehashrasha chad "miktzat hayyom kechullo" — amrinan, tere "miktzat hayyom kechullo" — la amrinan.

Mishna rabbi meir omer: kol melacha shehitchil bah kodem learbaa asar, gomrah bearbaa asar. aval lo yatchil bah battechilla bearbaa asar, af al pi sheyyachol legomrah. vachachamim omrim: shalosh ummaniyyot osin melacha bearve fesachim ad chatzot, veellu hen: hachayyaytin, vehassapparim, vehakkovsin. rabbi yose bar yehuda omer: af ratzanin.

Gemara ibbaya lehu: letzorech hammoed tenan, aval shello letzorech hammoed — afillu migmar name la, o dilma: shello letzorech hammoed tenan, aval letzorech — atchole matchalinan, o dilma: ben letzorech hammoed ben shello letzorech, migmar — in, atchole — la.

Ta shema: aval lo yatchil battechilla bearbaa asar afillu tziltzol katan afillu sevacha ketanna. may "afillu"? lav afillu hane, diltzorech hammoed, migmar — in, atchole — la?! mikkelal deshello letzorech — migmar name la gamrinan!

La, leolam deshello letzorech migmar name gamrinan, umay "afillu"? afillu hane name, dezutere ninhu, desalka datach amena hatechalatan zo hi gemar melachtan — natchel behu name lechattechilla, kamashma lan.
Ta shema. rabbi meir omer: kol melacha shehi letzorech hammoed —
b: Gomrah bearbaa asar, ematay? bizman shehitchil bah kodem arbaa asar, aval lo hitchil bah kodem arbaa asar — lo yatchil bah bearbaa asar, afillu tziltzol katan, afillu sevacha ketanna. letzorech hammoed — in, shello letzorech hammoed — la. hu haddin daafillu shello letzorech name gamrinan, veha ka mashma lan daafillu letzorech hammoed, migmar — in, atchole — la.

Ta shema, rabbi meir omer: kol melacha shehi letzorech hammoed — gomrah bearbaa asar, vesheenah letzorech hammoed — asur, veosin melacha bearve fesachim ad chatzot bimkom shennahagu. mekom shennahagu — in, lo nahagu — la, ushema minna: letzorech hammoed — in, shello letzorech hammoed — la. shema minna.

Vachachamim omrim shalosh ummaniyyot. tana: hachayyaytin, shekken hedyot tofer kedarko bechullo shel moed. hassapparin vehakkovsin, shekken habba mimmedinat hayyam vehayyotze mibbet haasurin mesapperin umechabbesin bechullo shel moed. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: af haratzanin, shekken ole regalim metakkenin minalehen bechullo shel moed.
Bemay kamippalgi? mar savar: lemedin techillat melacha missof melacha, umar savar: en lemedin techillat melacha missof melacha.

Mishna moshivin shovachin letarnegolim bearbaa asar. vetarnegolet shebbarcha — machazirin otah limkomah, veim meta — moshivin acheret tachteha. gorfin mittachat ragle behema bearbaa asar, uvammoed mesallekin litzdadin. molichin kelim umeviin mibbet haumman — af al pi sheenam letzorech hammoed.
Gemara hasheta otove motvinan, ahdore mibbaya?! amar abbaye: sefa atan lechullo shel moed.

Amar rav huna: lo shanu ella toch shelosha lemirdah — deakkatti la perach tzimra minna, veachar shelosha lishivatah — defasda la bee ligmare. aval leachar shelosha lemirdah, difrach la tzimra minna, vetoch shelosha lishivatah, deakkatti la pesidi bee ligmare — la mahderinan. rabbi amme amar: afillu toch shelosha lishivatah mahderinan.
Bemay kamippalgi? mar savar: lehefsed merubbe chashshu, lehefsed muat — lo chashshu, umar savar: lehefsed muat name chashshu.
Gorfin mittachat. tanu rabbanan: hazzevel shebbechatzer mesallekin oto litzdadin, shebbarefet veshebbechatzer motziin oto laashpa.

Ha gufa kashya, amrat: zevel shebbechatzer mesallekin oto litzdadin, vahadar tane: shebbarefet veshebbechatzer motziin oto laashpa! amar abbaye: la kashya, kan bearbaa asar, kan bechullo shel moed. rava amar: ha veha bechullo shel moed, vehachi kaamar: im naasa chatzer kerefet — motziin oto laashpa.

Molichin kelim umeviin mibbet haumman. amar rav pappa: badek lan rava. tenan: molichin umeviin kelim mibbet haumman, af al pi sheenan letzorech hammoed. ureminhu: en meviin kelim mibbet haumman, veim choshesh lahen shemma yigganvu — mefannan lechatzer acheret!
Umeshannenan, la kashya: kan — bearbaa asar, kan — bechullo shel moed. veibbaet ema, ha veha bechullo shel moed, vela kashya: kan — bemaamino, kan — besheeno maamino.

Vehatanya: meviin kelim mibbet haumman, kegon hakkad mibbet hakkaddar, vehakkos mibbet hazzaggag. aval lo tzemer mibbet hatztzabba, velo kelim mibbet haumman, veim en lo ma yochal — noten lo secharo umannicho etzlo. veim eno maamino — mannichan bevayit hassamuch lo. veim choshesh shemma yigganvu — mevian betzina betoch beto.
Taretzt meviin. molichin kashya, dekatane: en meviin vechol shekken deen molichin! ella mechavvavrta kidshanninan meikkara.

Mishna shishsha devarim asu anshe yericho, al shelosha michu beyadam veal shelosha lo michu beyadam. veellu hen shello michu beyadam: markivin dekalim kol hayyom, vechorchin et shema, vekotzrin vegodshin lifne haomer. veellu shemmichu beyadam: mattirin gamziyyot shel hekdesh,

a: Veochlin mittachat hannesharim beshabbat, venotnin pea layyarak. umichu beyadam chachamim.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: shishsha devarim asa chizkiyya hammelech, al shelosha hodu lo, veal shelosha lo hodu lo: gerar atzmot aviv al mitta shel chavalim — vehodu lo. kittat nechash hannechoshet — vehodu lo. ganaz sefer refuot — vehodu lo.
Veal shelosha lo hodu lo: kitztzetz delatot shel hechol veshiggeran lemelech ashshur — velo hodu lo. satam me gichon haelyon — velo hodu lo. ibber nisan benisan — velo hodu lo.

Markivin dekalim kol hayyom vechulei. hechi avdi? amar rav yehuda: mayyte asa dara veshichra dedafna vekimcha disare dirme bemana dela chalfi aleh arbein yomin, umartechi lehu, veshadu lehu ledikla belibbeh, vechol dekae bearba ammot dideh, i la avdi leh hachi — tzave lealtar. rav acha bereh derava amar: mannechi kufera dichra lenukebta.

Vechorchin et shema. hechi avdi? amar rav yehuda: omrim "shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad", velo hayu mafsikin. rava amar: mafsikin hayu, ella shehayu omrim "hayyom al levavecha", demashma: hayyom al levavecha, velo machar al levavecha. tanu rabbanan: ketzad hayu korchin et shema? omrim "shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad", velo hayu mafsikin, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: mafsikin hayu, ella shello hayu omrim "baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed".
Vaanan, may tama amrinan leh? kiddaresh rabbi shimon ben lakish.

Deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish: "vayyikra yaakov el banav vayyomer heasfu veaggida lachem". bikkesh yaakov legallot levanav ketz hayyamin, venistalleka mimmennu shechina. amar: shemma chas veshalom yesh bemittati pesul, keavraham sheyyatza mimmennu yishmael, veavi yitzchak sheyyatza mimmennu esav? amru lo banav: "shema yisrael, Adonai elohenu Adonai echad". amru: keshem sheen belibbecha ella echad, kach en belibbenu ella echad. beotah shaa patach yaakov avinu veamar: "baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed".

Amri rabbanan: hechi naaved? nemreh, lo amaro moshe rabbenu. la nemreh, amaro yaakov. hitkinu sheyyehu omrim oto bachashay. amar rabbi yitzchak, amri deve rabbi amme: mashal levat melech shehericha tzike kedera. im tomar — yesh lah genay. lo tomar — yesh lah tzaar. hitchilu avadeha lehavi bachashay.
Amar rabbi avahu: hitkinu sheyyehu omrim oto bekol ram, mippene taromet hamminin. uvinhardea, delekka minin, ad hasheta amri la bachashay.

Tanu rabbanan: shishsha devarim asu anshe yericho, shelosha birtzon chachamim, ushelosha shello birtzon chachamim. veellu birtzon chachamim: markivin dekalim kol hayyom, vechorchin et shema, vekotzrin lifne haomer. veellu shello birtzon chachamim: godshin lifne haomer, ufortzin peratzot begannotehen uvefardesotehen lehaachil nesher laaniyyim bishne vatztzoret beshabbatot veyamim tovim, umattirin gamziyyot shel hekdesh shel charuv veshel shikma, divre rabbi meir.
Amar lo rabbi yehuda: im birtzon chachamim hayu osin, yehu kol adam osin ken. ella: ellu vaellu shello birtzon chachamim hayu osin, al shelosha michu beyadam, veal shelosha lo michu beyadam.

Veellu shello michu beyadam: markivin dekalim kol hayyom, vechorchin et shema, vekotzrin vegodshin lifne haomer. veellu shemmichu beyadam: mattirin gamziyyot shel hekdesh shel charuv veshel shikma, ufortzin peratzot begannotehen ufardesehen lehaachil nesher laaniyyim beshabbatot veyamim tovim bishne vatztzoret, notnin pea layyarak, umichu beyadam chachamim.

Vesavar rabbi yehuda ketzira shello birtzon chachamim hi? vehatnan: anshe yericho kotzrin lifne haomer birtzon chachamim, vegodshin lifne haomer shello birtzon chachamim, velo michu beyadam chachamim.
b: Man shamat leh deamar "michu" velo michu" — rabbi yehuda. vekatane: kotzrin birtzon chachamim! velitamaych, hane arbea hava! ella: semi mikkan ketzira.

Umattirin gamziyyot shel hekdesh shel charuv veshel shikma. amru: avotenu lo hikdishu ella korot, veanu nattir gamziyyot shel hekdesh shel charuv veshel shikma. uvegiddulin habbain leachar mikkan askinan, vesavri la keman deamar: en meila begiddulin. verabbanan savri: nehi dimila lekka, issura miha ikka.

Ufortzin peratzot. amar ulla amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: machloket beshel machbedot, derabbanan savri: gazrinan shemma yaale veyitlosh, veanshe yericho savri: la gazrinan shemma yaale veyitlosh. aval beshel ben hakkippin — divre hakkol muttar.

Amar leh rava: veha muketzot ninhu. vechi tema: hoil dachaze leorvin. hasheta muchan leadam la have muchan lichlavim, ditnan: rabbi yehuda omer: im lo hayta nevela meerev shabbat — asura, lefi sheenah min hammuchan, muchan leorvim have muchan leadam?!
Amar leh: in, muchan leadam — la have muchan lichlavim, dechol midde dachaze leinish, la maktze leh middateh. muchan leorvim — have muchan leadam, kol midde dachaze leinish, dateh illaveh.

Ki ata ravin, amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: machloket beshel ben kippin, derabbanan savri: muchan leorvim — la have muchan leadam, veanshe yericho savri: muchan laorvim — have muchan leadam, aval beshel machbedot — divre hakkol asur, gazrinan shemma yaale veyitlosh.
Venotnin pea layyarak. velet lehu leanshe yericho ha ditnan, kelal amru bappea: kol shehu ochel, venishmar, vegiddulo min haaretz, ulekitato keachat, umachniso lekiyyum — chayyayv befea.

"Kol shehu ochel" — perat lisfiche setis vekotza. "venishmar" —perat lehefker. "vegiddulo min haaretz" — perat lichmehin ufitriyyot. "ulekitatan keachat" — perat litenim. "umachniso lekiyyum" — perat leyarak.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: hacha berashe lefatot askinan, umachniso lekiyyum al yede davar acher kamippalgi. mar savar: machniso lekiyyum al yede davar acher — shemeh kiyyum, umar savar: la shemeh kiyyum.
Tanu rabbanan: barishona hayu notnin pea lelefet velichruv, rabbi yose omer: af lekaflot. vetanya iddach: hayu notnin pea lelefet ulekaflot, rabbi shimon omer: af lichruv.

a: Nema telata tannae havo? la, tere tannae havo, vetanna kamma derabbi shimon hayeynu rabbi yose, vetanna kamma derabbi yose hayeynu rabbi shimon. umay "af" — akkammayyta.

Tanu rabbanan: ben buheyayn natan pea layyarak, uva aviv umetzaan laaniyyim shehayu teunin yarak veomdin al petach hagginna. amar lahem: banay, hashelichu mealechem vaani noten lachem kiflayim bamussar. lo mippene sheeni tzara, ella mippene sheamru chachamim: en notnin pea layyarak.
Lema leh lememra lehu "lo mippene sheeni tzara"? ki hechi dela lemru: dachoye ka medache lan.

Tanu rabbanan: barishona hayu mannichin orot kadashim belishkat bet happarva, laerev hayu mechallekin otan leanshe bet av. vehayu baale zeroot notlin otan bizroa. hitkinu sheyyihyu mechallekin otan meerev shabbat leerev shabbat — deatyayn kullehu mishmarot, veshaklan bahadade.
Vaadayin hayu gedole chehunna notlin otan bizroa. amdu bealim vehikdishum lashshamayim.

Amru: lo hayu yamim muatim ad shechippu et hahechol kullo betavlaot shel zahav, shehen amma al amma keovi dinar zahav, uleregel hayu mekappelin otan umannichin otan al gav maala behar habbayit, kede sheyyehu ole regalim roin shemmelachtam naa veen bah delem.
Tana, abba shaul omer: korot shel shikma hayu biricho, vehayu baale zeroot notlin otan bizroa, amdu bealim vehikdishum lashshamayim.

Alehem veal kayyotze bahem amar abba shaul ben batnit mishshum abba yosef ben chanin: oy li mibbet bayytos — oy li mealatan, oy li mibbet chanin — oy li millechishatan, oy li mibbet katros — oy li mikkulemosan, oy li mibbet yishmael ben piachi — oy li meegrofan. shehem kohanim gedolim, uvenehen gizbarin, vechatnehem amarkalin, veavdehen chovtin et haam bemaklot.

Tanu rabbanan: arba tzevochot tzavcha azara. rishona: tzeu mikkan bene eli shettimmeu hechal Adonai. veod tzavvcha: tze mikkan yissaschar ish kefar barkay shemmechabbed et atzmo umechallel kodshe shamayim. dahava karech yedeh beshirae veaved avoda.

Veod tzavvcha haazara: seu shearim rashechem veyikkanes yishmael ben piachi talmido shel pinchas, vishammesh bichhunna gedola. veod tzavvcha haazara: seu shearim rashechem veyikkanes yochanan ben nirbay talmido shel pinkay vimalle kereso mikkodshe shamayim.

Amru alav al yochanan ben nirbay shehaya ochel shelosh meot agalim, veshote shelosh meot garve yayin, veochel arbaim sea gozalot bekinnuach seuda. amru: kol yamav shel yochanan ben nirbay lo nimtza notar bemikdash. may selika beh beyissasochar ish kefar barkay? amri: malka umalketa havo yatvi. malka amar: gadya yae, umalketa amra: immera yae. amaru: man mochach? kohen gadol, deka massek korbanot kol yoma. ata ihu,
b: Achvi bideh: i gadya yae, yissak litmida. amar malka: hoil vela have leh emta demalchuta, nifseku leyammineh. yehav shochad ufaskeh lismaleh. shema malka ufaskeh leyammineh. amar rav yosef: berich rachamana deashkeleh leyissasochar ish kefar barkay lemitrafseh minneh behay alma.

Amar rav ashe: yissaschar ish kefar barkay la tena matnitin. ditnan, rabbi shimon omer: kevasim kodmim laizzim bechol makom, yachol mippene shemmuvecharin beminan — talmud lomar: "im keves yavi korbano", melammed sheshshenehen shekulin keechad. ravina amar: afillu mikra name la kera, dichtiv: "im keves", "im ez", i bae keves — layyteh, i bae ez — layyteh.
Haderan alach makom shennahagu uselika la pesach rishon

a: Mishna tamid nishchat bishmona umechtza, vekarev betisha umechtza. bearve fesachim nishchat besheva umechtza, vekarev bishmone umechtza — ben bachol ben beshabbat. chal erev pesach lihyot beerev shabbat, nishchat beshesh umechtza, vekarev besheva umechtza, vehappesach acharav.
Gemara mena hane mille?

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi, deamar kera: "et hakkeves echad taase vabboker veet hakkeves hashsheni taase ben haarbayim", challekehu leven shene aravim: shete shaot umechtza lechan, shete shaot umechtza lechan, veshaa achat laasiyyayto.
Metiv rava: bearve fesachim nishchat besheva umechtza, vekarev bishmone umechtza — ben bachol ben beshabbat! vei salka datach bishmone umechtza deorayyta, hechi makdeminan leh?
Ella amar rava: mitzvato detamid mishsheyyinnatu tzille erev. may tama? deamar kera: "ben haarbayim", meiddana dematchel shimsha lemirav.
Hilkach, bishar yemot hashshana deikka nedarim unedavot, derachamana amar: "aleha chelve hashshelamim",
Veamar mar ("aleha chelve hashshelamim"): aleha hashelem kol hakkarbanot kullam — meacharinan leh tarte shae, veavdinan leh bishmone umechtza.

Bearve fesachim, deikka pesach acharav, kadminan leh shaa achat, veavdinan leh besheva umechtza. chal erev pesach lihyot erev shabbat, deikka name tzeliyyayto dela dache shabbat — mokminan leh addineh, beshesh umechtza.
Tanu rabbanan: kesidduro bachol kach sidduro bashshabbat, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: kesidduro beerev pesach.

May kaamar? amar abbaye, hachi kaamar: kesidduro bachol beerev happesach kach sidduro bashshabbat beerev happesach, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: kesidduro beerev happesach shechal lihyot beerev shabbat kach sidduro bashshabbat. umatnitin dekatane ben bachol ben bashshabbat — rabbi yishmael hi.

Bemay ka mippalgi? bemusafin kodmin levazichin kamippalgi. rabbi yishmael savar: musafin kodmin levazichin. aved lehu lemusafin beshesh, uvazichin besheva, veaved leh letamid besheva umechtza. rabbi akiva savar: bazichin kodmin lemusafin. bazichin bechamesh, umusafin beshesh, veaved leh letamid beshesh umechtza.

Matkef la rava: midde rabbi akiva "kesidro beerev happesach shechal lihyot beerev shabbat" katane?! kesidro beerev happesach setama katane. ella amar rava, hachi kaamar: kesidro bechol dealma — kach sidro bashshabbat beerev happesach, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: kesidro beerev happesach. umatnitin dekatane ben bachol ben bashshabbat, rabbi akiva hi.
Bemay ka mippalgi? bemichmar bisra kamippalgi. rabbi yishmael savar: chayyshinan lemichmar bisra. verabbi akiva savar: la chayyshinan lemichmar bisra.
b: I la chayyshinan, nibedeh beshesh umechtza? ka savar: musafin kodmin levazichin. aved lehu lemusafin beshesh, uvazichin besheva, veaved leh letamid besheva umechtza.
Matkef la rabba bar ulla: midde "kesidro bachol kach sidro bashshabbat beerev happesach, divre rabbi yishmael" katane?! "kach sidro bashshabbat" setama katane?
Ella amar rabba bar ulla, hachi katane: kesidro bechol dealma — kach sidro beshabbat dealma, divre rabbi yishmael.
Rabbi akiva omer: kesidro beerev happesach dealma — kach sidro beshabbat dealma. umatnitin dekatane ben bachol ben bashshabbat — divre hakkol hi.
Bemay kamippalgi? bigzerat nedavot unedarim kamippalgi. rabbi yishmael savar: gazrinan shabbat attu chol, verabbi akiva savar: la gazrinan.
I la gazrinan, nibedeh beshesh umechtza! kasavar: musafin kodmin levazichin. musafin beshesh, uvazichin besheva, veaved leh letamid besheva umechtza.

Metivi: tamid, kol hashshana kullah karev kehilchato: nishchat bishmone umechtza, vekarev betesha umechtza. uvaerev happesach, nishchat besheva umechtza, vekarev bishmone umechtza. chal lihyot bashshabbat kechal lihyot besheni bashshabbat, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: kesidro beerev happesach.
Bishlama leabbaye nicha, ella lerava kashya. amar lach rava: la tema "kechal besheni bashshabbat", ella ema: kesheni bashshabbat dealma.
Metivi: chal lihyot bashshabbat — kesidro kol hashshana kullah, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: kesidro beerev happesach dealma. bishlama lerava nicha, ella leabbaye kashya!
Amar lach abbaye: la tema "kesidro kol hashshana", ella ema: kesidro kol hashshanim kullan, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: kesidro erev happesach shechal lihyot beerev shabbat.
Tanu rabbanan: minnayin shello yehe davar kodem letamid shel shachar, talmud lomar: "vearach aleha haola". may talmuda? amar rava: "haola" — ola rishona.
Uminnayin sheen davar karev achar tamid shel ben haarbayim, talmud lomar: "vehiktir aleha chelve hashshelamim". may talmuda? amar abbaye: "aleha" shelamim, velo al chavertah shelamim.
Matkef la rava: ema shelamim hu dela nakrev, ha olot nakrev! ella amar rava: "hashshelamim" — aleha hashelem kol hakkarbanot kullan.
Tanu rabbanan: tamid kodem lefesach, pesach kodem liktoret, ketoret kodemet lenerot.
